name: Characterizing Unintended Consequences in Human-GUI Agent Collaboration for Web Browsing
summary: Studies unintended consequences of collaborative web browsing with GUI agents through social-media analysis and interviews. It organizes observed failures, user impacts, and mitigation practices around planning, interface interaction, feedback, privacy, and trust.
authors: Shuning Zhang; Jingruo Chen; Zhiqi Gao; Jiajing Gao; Xin Yi; Hewu Li

name: LLM-Explorer: Towards Efficient and Affordable LLM-based Exploration for Mobile Apps
summary: LLM-Explorer uses language models to maintain compact knowledge for mobile app exploration, then generates actions without invoking the model at every step. The study compares exploration coverage and cost across twenty apps.
authors: Shanhui Zhao; Hao Wen; Wenjie Du; Cheng Liang; Yunxin Liu; Xiaozhou Ye; Ye Ouyang; Yuanchun Li

name: Creating General User Models from Computer Use
summary: Proposes general user models that turn computer-use observations into confidence-weighted propositions and revise them as new context arrives. Demonstrations use this memory to contextualize assistants, manage notifications, and support proactive actions across apps.
authors: Omar Shaikh; Shardul Sapkota; Shan Rizvi; Eric Horvitz; Joon Sung Park; Diyi Yang; Michael S. Bernstein

name: InfantAgent-Next: A Multimodal Generalist Agent for Automated Computer Interaction
summary: Introduces InfantAgent-Next, a modular multimodal computer agent that combines tool-based and vision agents for stepwise tasks, with evaluation on OSWorld and other benchmarks.
authors: Bin Lei; Weitai Kang; Zijian Zhang; Winson Chen; Xi Xie; Shan Zuo; Mimi Xie; Ali Payani; Mingyi Hong; Yan Yan; Caiwen Ding

name: A Survey on the Safety and Security Threats of Computer-Using Agents: JARVIS or Ultron?
summary: Systematizes safety and security threats to computer-using agents, with taxonomies of threats and defensive strategies.
authors: Ada Chen; Yongjiang Wu; Junyuan Zhang; Jingyu Xiao; Shu Yang; Jen-tse Huang; Kun Wang; Wenxuan Wang; Shuai Wang

name: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
summary: Introduces Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), an RL method for assigning step-level credit in multi-turn agents, evaluated on WebShop among other tasks.
authors: Lang Feng; Zhenghai Xue; Tingcong Liu; Bo An

name: WebInject: Prompt Injection Attack to Web Agents
summary: Introduces WebInject, a prompt-injection attack that optimizes rendered webpage pixels to make screenshot-based web agents take attacker-chosen actions.
authors: Xilong Wang; John Bloch; Zedian Shao; Yuepeng Hu; Shuyan Zhou; Neil Zhenqiang Gong

name: Mobile-Bench-v2: A More Realistic and Comprehensive Benchmark for VLM-based Mobile Agents
summary: Mobile-Bench-v2 evaluates mobile GUI agents using multiple acceptable offline action paths, noisy interfaces with ads or pop-ups, and ambiguous instructions with scripted clarification exchanges. These splits separate step-level execution, robustness, and proactive interaction.
authors: Weikai Xu; Zhizheng Jiang; Yuxuan Liu; Pengzhi Gao; Wei Liu; Jian Luan; Yuanchun Li; Yunxin Liu; Bin Wang; Bo An
venue: International Conference on Learning Representations

name: MobileIPL: Enhancing Mobile Agents Thinking Process via Iterative Preference Learning
summary: MobileIPL samples trees of action-planning thoughts, propagates rule-based leaf rewards backward, and forms preference pairs for reasoning-level optimization. It also expands screenshot-based instruction data through staged evolution before evaluation on mobile GUI-agent benchmarks.
authors: Kun Huang; Weikai Xu; Yuxuan Liu; Quandong Wang; Pengzhi Gao; Wei Liu; Jian Luan; Bin Wang; Bo An

name: Enhancing Visual Grounding for GUI Agents via Self-Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning
summary: Proposes GUI grounding training that combines curated seed examples, continuous location-dependent policy feedback, and iterative refinement guided by attention maps. The study evaluates the resulting reinforcement-learning procedure on three grounding benchmarks, including ScreenSpot-Pro.
authors: Xinbin Yuan; Jian Zhang; Kaixin Li; Zhuoxuan Cai; Lujian Yao; Jie Chen; Enguang Wang; Qibin Hou; Jinwei Chen; Peng-Tao Jiang; Bo Li

name: GUI-Shift: Enhancing VLM-Based GUI Agents through Self-supervised Reinforcement Learning
summary: GUI-Shift trains an inverse-dynamics task that predicts the initial action connecting two GUI states, using trajectories without natural-language instructions. It combines rule-based reinforcement learning with data filtering and evaluates transfer to Android automation and screenshot grounding.
authors: Longxi Gao; Li Zhang; Pengzhi Gao; Wei Liu; Jian Luan; Mengwei Xu

name: Scalable Video-to-Dataset Generation for Cross-Platform Mobile Agents
summary: Introduces MONDAY and an automated pipeline that extracts mobile-navigation training data from instructional videos across operating-system platforms.
authors: Yunseok Jang; Yeda Song; Sungryull Sohn; Lajanugen Logeswaran; Tiange Luo; Dong-Ki Kim; Kyunghoon Bae; Honglak Lee

name: GEM: Gaussian Embedding Modeling for Out-of-Distribution Detection in GUI Agents
summary: GEM detects instructions outside a GUI agent’s capabilities by modeling distances in its input-embedding space with a Gaussian mixture. Experiments across mobile, computer and browser data also examine selective escalation to a cloud model when an input is detected as unfamiliar.
authors: Zheng Wu; Pengzhou Cheng; Zongru Wu; Lingzhong Dong; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: From Assistants to Adversaries: Exploring the Security Risks of Mobile LLM Agents
summary: Analyzes security vulnerabilities across OEM system-level, third-party, and research mobile LLM agents, covering GUI and cross-application attack surfaces.
authors: Liangxuan Wu; Chao Wang; Tianming Liu; Yanjie Zhao; Haoyu Wang

name: The Hidden Dangers of Browsing AI Agents
summary: Outlines an end-to-end threat model and empirical security evaluation across architectural layers of autonomous browser agents.
authors: Mykyta Mudryi; Markiyan Chaklosh; Grzegorz Wójcik

name: Scaling Computer-Use Grounding via User Interface Decomposition and Synthesis
summary: Introduces OSWorld-G grounding evaluation and the Jedi synthesis pipeline for examples spanning layout reasoning and fine-grained interaction.
authors: Tianbao Xie; Jiaqi Deng; Xiaochuan Li; Junlin Yang; Haoyuan Wu; Jixuan Chen; Wenjing Hu; Xinyuan Wang; Yuhui Xu; Zekun Wang; Yiheng Xu; Junli Wang; Doyen Sahoo; Tao Yu; Caiming Xiong

name: Efficient Agent Training for Computer Use
summary: PC Agent-E augments 312 human computer-use trajectories with alternative action decisions synthesized by Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It studies training with this combination and introduces WindowsAgentArena-V2 as an updated evaluation benchmark.
authors: Yanheng He; Jiahe Jin; Pengfei Liu

name: Building a Stable Planner: An Extended Finite State Machine Based Planning Module for Mobile GUI Agent
summary: SPlanner models mobile-app functions and configurations with extended finite-state machines, traverses them to construct execution paths, and converts those paths into natural-language plans. A VLM follows these plans to perform GUI actions, with evaluation on AndroidWorld.
authors: Fanglin Mo; Junzhe Chen; Haoxuan Zhu; Xuming Hu

name: EVA: Evolving Semantic Adversaries for Red-Teaming GUI Agents Against Environmental Injection Attacks
summary: Introduces EVA, a red-teaming framework that evolves semantic payloads for GUI environmental-injection tests. It studies the contribution of semantic versus visual deception and distills discovered patterns into reusable evaluation rules.
authors: Yijie Lu; Manman Zhao; Tianjie Ju; Zihe Yan; Xinbei Ma; Yuan Guo; Daizong Ding; Gongshen Liu; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: Hidden Ghost Hand: Unveiling Backdoor Vulnerabilities in MLLM-Powered Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Studies backdoor risks in mobile GUI agents through AgentGhost, which combines goal-level and interaction-history triggers during model training. The paper evaluates multiple mobile agents and a tailored defense.
authors: Pengzhou Cheng; Haowen Hu; Zheng Wu; Zongru Wu; Tianjie Ju; Zhuosheng Zhang; Gongshen Liu

name: MedBrowseComp: Benchmarking Medical Deep Research and Computer Use
summary: Introduces MedBrowseComp, a benchmark of human-curated, multi-hop medical questions for agents retrieving and synthesizing facts from live knowledge bases in a computer-use setting.
authors: Shan Chen; Pedro Moreira; Yuxin Xiao; Sam Schmidgall; Jeremy Warner; Hugo Aerts; Thomas Hartvigsen; Jack Gallifant; Danielle S. Bitterman

name: ReGUIDE: Data Efficient GUI Grounding via Spatial Reasoning and Search
summary: Combines self-generated localization reasoning, spatial consistency checks, and inference-time search to improve data-efficient web grounding.
authors: Hyunseok Lee; Jeonghoon Kim; Beomjun Kim; Jihoon Tack; Chansong Jo; Jaehong Lee; Cheonbok Park; Sookyo In; Jinwoo Shin; Kang Min Yoo

name: Web-Shepherd: Advancing PRMs for Reinforcing Web Agents
summary: Web-Shepherd is a process reward model for assessing individual steps of web-navigation trajectories. It introduces a collection of 40,000 step-level preference pairs with checklists and a separate benchmark for comparing reward models, then evaluates verification during WebArena-lite navigation.
authors: Hyungjoo Chae; Sunghwan Kim; Junhee Cho; Seungone Kim; Seungjun Moon; Gyeom Hwangbo; Dongha Lim; Minjin Kim; Yeonjun Hwang; Minju Gwak; Dongwook Choi; Minseok Kang; Gwanhoon Im; ByeongUng Cho; Hyojun Kim; Jun Hee Han; Taeyoon Kwon; Minju Kim; Beong-woo Kwak; Dongjin Kang; Jinyoung Yeo

name: GUI-G1: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training for Visual Grounding in GUI Agents
summary: Analyzes reasoning templates, reward design, and policy updates in GUI grounding, then proposes targeted adjustments to the training process.
authors: Yuqi Zhou; Sunhao Dai; Shuai Wang; Kaiwen Zhou; Qinglin Jia; Jun Xu

name: AutoData: A Multi-Agent System for Open Web Data Collection
summary: Introduces AutoData, a multi-agent system that collects web datasets from a natural-language request, and Instruct2DS, a benchmark for live collection across three domains.
authors: Tianyi Ma; Yiyue Qian; Zheyuan Zhang; Zehong Wang; Xiaoye Qian; Feifan Bai; Yifan Ding; Xuwei Luo; Shinan Zhang; Keerthiram Murugesan; Chuxu Zhang; Yanfang Ye

name: ARPO:End-to-End Policy Optimization for GUI Agents with Experience Replay
summary: ARPO extends group-relative policy optimization with a replay buffer that reuses successful GUI trajectories across training iterations. It filters tasks using baseline performance and compares end-to-end reinforcement learning with offline preference optimization on OSWorld.
authors: Fanbin Lu; Zhisheng Zhong; Shu Liu; Chi-Wing Fu; Jiaya Jia

name: WebAgent-R1: Training Web Agents via End-to-End Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
summary: Trains web agents through asynchronous multi-turn environment interaction, using task-success rewards to optimize complete trajectories.
authors: Zhepei Wei; Wenlin Yao; Yao Liu; Weizhi Zhang; Qin Lu; Liang Qiu; Changlong Yu; Puyang Xu; Chao Zhang; Bing Yin; Hyokun Yun; Lihong Li

name: Unlocking Smarter Device Control: Foresighted Planning with a World Model-Driven Code Execution Approach
summary: FPWC builds and refines a task-oriented world model before planning mobile-device actions. It executes plans as code and evaluates the approach in simulated environments and on real mobile devices.
authors: Xiaoran Yin; Xu Luo; Hao Wu; Lianli Gao; Jingkuan Song

name: GUI-explorer: Autonomous Exploration and Mining of Transition-aware Knowledge for GUI Agent
summary: GUI-explorer generates exploration goals from screenshots and interface structure, then mines observation-action-outcome triples for app-specific transition knowledge. The resulting training-free agent uses this knowledge during mobile task execution, evaluated on SPA-Bench and AndroidWorld.
authors: Bin Xie; Rui Shao; Gongwei Chen; Kaiwen Zhou; Yinchuan Li; Jie Liu; Min Zhang; Liqiang Nie
venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)

name: TransBench: Breaking Barriers for Transferable Graphical User Interface Agents in Dynamic Digital Environments
summary: Introduces TransBench to evaluate GUI grounding transfer across app versions, iOS, Android, Web, and functionally distinct applications.
authors: Yuheng Lu; Qian Yu; Hongru Wang; Zeming Liu; Wei Su; Yanping Liu; Yuhang Guo; Maocheng Liang; Yunhong Wang; Haifeng Wang

name: Automated Testing of the GUI of a Real-Life Engineering Software using Large Language Models
summary: GERALLT uses LLMs to explore the GUI of engineering software and produce a list of confusing or inconsistent interface areas for developers to inspect.
authors: Tim Rosenbach; David Heidrich; Alexander Weinert
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Software Testing, Verification and Validation Workshops (ICSTW)

name: ProgRM: Build Better GUI Agents with Progress Rewards
summary: ProgRM predicts per-step task completion progress to provide intermediate rewards during online GUI-agent training. It derives progress labels by using longest common subsequences to identify key trajectory steps, allowing useful partial progress to contribute even when a trajectory ultimately fails.
authors: Danyang Zhang; Situo Zhang; Ziyue Yang; Zichen Zhu; Zihan Zhao; Ruisheng Cao; Lu Chen; Kai Yu

name: LiteCUA: Computer as MCP Server for Computer-Use Agent on AIOS
summary: AIOS 1.0 exposes computer states and actions through an MCP server to provide structured environmental context for agents. LiteCUA is a lightweight agent built on this interface, evaluated on OSWorld to study the effect of computer-environment contextualization.
authors: Kai Mei; Xi Zhu; Hang Gao; Shuhang Lin; Yongfeng Zhang

name: ScreenExplorer: Training a Vision-Language Model for Diverse Exploration in Open GUI World
summary: Trains ScreenExplorer with reinforcement learning in dynamic GUI environments, using a world-model curiosity reward and experience-stream distillation to support sustained exploration.
authors: Runliang Niu; Jinglong Ji; Yi Chang; Qi Wang

name: ScienceBoard: Evaluating Multimodal Autonomous Agents in Realistic Scientific Workflows
summary: ScienceBoard combines an interactive environment with professional scientific software and 169 human-curated tasks in areas including biochemistry, astronomy, and geoinformatics. It evaluates computer-use agents on visually rich research workflows and analyzes their execution limitations.
authors: Qiushi Sun; Zhoumianze Liu; Chang Ma; Zichen Ding; Fangzhi Xu; Zhangyue Yin; Haiteng Zhao; Zhenyu Wu; Kanzhi Cheng; Zhaoyang Liu; Jianing Wang; Qintong Li; Xiangru Tang; Tianbao Xie; Xiachong Feng; Xiang Li; Ben Kao; Wenhai Wang; Biqing Qi; Lingpeng Kong; Zhiyong Wu

name: WebCoT: Enhancing Web Agent Reasoning by Reconstructing Chain-of-Thought in Reflection, Branching, and Rollback
summary: WebCoT turns reflection, look-ahead, branching and rollback procedures into chain-of-thought training rationales. Fine-tuning on these reconstructed trajectories is evaluated for web-agent self-improvement and transfer across navigation tasks.
authors: Minda Hu; Tianqing Fang; Jianshu Zhang; Junyu Ma; Zhisong Zhang; Jingyan Zhou; Hongming Zhang; Haitao Mi; Dong Yu; Irwin King

name: Training LLM-Based Agents with Synthetic Self-Reflected Trajectories and Partial Masking
summary: Introduces STeP, which trains agents on synthetic trajectories containing error reflections and corrections while masking poor steps; WebShop is one of three evaluated tasks.
authors: Yihan Chen; Benfeng Xu; Xiaorui Wang; Yongdong Zhang; Zhendong Mao

name: BacktrackAgent: Enhancing GUI Agent with Error Detection and Backtracking Mechanism
summary: BacktrackAgent adds verification, judgment, and reflection modules to detect erroneous GUI actions and guide recovery. It develops backtracking-oriented training data that includes post-action pages and evaluates task completion and step accuracy on Mobile3M and Auto-UI.
authors: Qinzhuo Wu; Pengzhi Gao; Wei Liu; Jian Luan

name: SPA-RL: Reinforcing LLM Agents via Stepwise Progress Attribution
summary: Introduces SPA, a reward redistribution method for multi-step LLM agents that estimates each action’s contribution to task completion; Webshop is among its evaluations.
authors: Hanlin Wang; Chak Tou Leong; Jiashuo Wang; Jian Wang; Wenjie Li

name: XBOUND: Exploring Capability Boundaries of Device-Control Agents at the State Level
summary: XBOUND evaluates GUI agents at the level of a screen state, considering multiple instructions and possible target actions within it. The study separates action matching from instruction unification and compares effects of grounding and trajectory data.
authors: Shaoqing Zhang; Kehai Chen; Zhuosheng Zhang; Rumei Li; Rongxiang Weng; Yang Xiang; Min Zhang

name: UI-Genie: A Self-Improving Approach for Iteratively Boosting MLLM-based Mobile GUI Agents
summary: UI-Genie jointly improves a mobile GUI agent and a reward model that processes screenshots with interaction history and supplies action- and task-level feedback. Its data pipeline uses rule-based verification, corrupted trajectories, and hard negatives to support reward-guided exploration and iterative training.
authors: Han Xiao; Guozhi Wang; Yuxiang Chai; Zimu Lu; Weifeng Lin; Hao He; Lue Fan; Liuyang Bian; Rui Hu; Liang Liu; Shuai Ren; Yafei Wen; Xiaoxin Chen; Aojun Zhou; Hongsheng Li

name: AdInject: Real-World Black-Box Attacks on Web Agents via Advertising Delivery
summary: Studies advertising delivery as an indirect-injection channel for web agents under a black-box threat model. AdInject evaluates how static ad content shaped by website context can redirect browser actions.
authors: Haowei Wang; Junjie Wang; Xiaojun Jia; Rupeng Zhang; Mingyang Li; Zhe Liu; Yang Liu; Qing Wang

name: RedTeamCUA: Realistic Adversarial Testing of Computer-Use Agents in Hybrid Web-OS Environments
summary: RedTeamCUA combines a virtual-machine OS environment with containerized websites for controlled prompt-injection tests spanning both interfaces. Its RTC-Bench contains 864 examples and can initialize agents at injection points to separate attack susceptibility from navigation failures.
authors: Zeyi Liao; Jaylen Jones; Linxi Jiang; Yuting Ning; Eric Fosler-Lussier; Yu Su; Zhiqiang Lin; Huan Sun

name: UI-Evol: Automatic Knowledge Evolving for Computer Use Agents
summary: Introduces UI-Evol, which extracts action sequences from agent interactions and critiques external guidance against those traces. Evaluation on OSWorld examines how revised operational knowledge affects execution and behavioral consistency.
authors: Ziyun Zhang; Xinyi Liu; Xiaoyi Zhang; Jun Wang; Gang Chen; Yan Lu

name: WorkForceAgent-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLM-based Web Agents via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Uses rule-based rewards for output structure and action correctness to train reasoning for enterprise web navigation.
authors: Yuchen Zhuang; Di Jin; Jiaao Chen; Wenqi Shi; Hanrui Wang; Chao Zhang

name: Agent-SAMA: State-Aware Mobile Assistant
summary: Models mobile application execution as a finite-state machine to support planning, verification, and recovery across interface transitions.
authors: Linqiang Guo; Wei Liu; Yi Wen Heng; Tse-Hsun; Chen; Yang Wang

name: Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Visual Reasoning
summary: Introduces ViGoRL, a visual reasoning model trained to reference image coordinates and zoom during reasoning; its evaluations include GUI element localization.
authors: Gabriel Sarch; Snigdha Saha; Naitik Khandelwal; Ayush Jain; Michael J. Tarr; Aviral Kumar; Katerina Fragkiadaki

name: ZeroGUI: Automating Online GUI Learning at Zero Human Cost
summary: Combines generated tasks, estimated success rewards, and online reinforcement learning to automate GUI-agent interaction training.
authors: Chenyu Yang; Shiqian Su; Shi Liu; Xuan Dong; Yue Yu; Weijie Su; Xuehui Wang; Zhaoyang Liu; Jinguo Zhu; Hao Li; Wenhai Wang; Yu Qiao; Xizhou Zhu; Jifeng Dai

name: VideoCAD: A Dataset and Model for Learning Long-Horizon 3D CAD UI Interactions from Video
summary: Introduces synthetic CAD interaction videos, a model for learning interface actions from video, and evaluation tasks for spatial and long-horizon reasoning.
authors: Brandon Man; Ghadi Nehme; Md Ferdous Alam; Faez Ahmed

name: Agent-X: Evaluating Deep Multimodal Reasoning in Vision-Centric Agentic Tasks
summary: Introduces Agent-X, a benchmark of multi-step visual reasoning and tool use with step-level grading across six settings, including web browsing.
authors: Tajamul Ashraf; Amal Saqib; Hanan Ghani; Muhra AlMahri; Yuhao Li; Noor Ahsan; Umair Nawaz; Jean Lahoud; Hisham Cholakkal; Mubarak Shah; Philip Torr; Fahad Shahbaz Khan; Rao Muhammad Anwer; Salman Khan

name: Open CaptchaWorld: A Comprehensive Web-based Platform for Testing and Benchmarking Multimodal LLM Agents
summary: Open CaptchaWorld evaluates multimodal agents on interactive browser-based CAPTCHA puzzles. Its benchmark distinguishes task success from the depth of visual reasoning and interaction needed to complete a puzzle.
authors: Yaxin Luo; Zhaoyi Li; Jiacheng Liu; Jiacheng Cui; Xiaohan Zhao; Zhiqiang Shen

name: ResTest: Targeted Coverage of Residual Not-Covered Code Using Large Language Models for Web GUI Testing
summary: Introduces ResTest, which uses coverage reports and a state transition graph to infer untested web functions, then directs a GUI agent to execute them.
authors: Chenxu Liu; Zhiyu Gu; Guoquan Wu; Ying Zhang; Wei Yang; Jun Wei; Tao Xie

name: RiOSWorld: Benchmarking the Risk of Multimodal Computer-Use Agents
summary: Introduces RiOSWorld, a computer-use risk benchmark separating user-originated and environmental threats. It evaluates both risky-goal intent and goal completion across web and other computer applications.
authors: Jingyi Yang; Shuai Shao; Dongrui Liu; Jing Shao

name: AgentCPM-GUI: Building Mobile-Use Agents with Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
summary: Combines grounding pretraining, bilingual interaction trajectories, and reinforcement fine-tuning for mobile GUI actions.
authors: Zhong Zhang; Yaxi Lu; Yikun Fu; Yupeng Huo; Shenzhi Yang; Yesai Wu; Han Si; Xin Cong; Haotian Chen; Yankai Lin; Jie Xie; Wei Zhou; Wang Xu; Yuanheng Zhang; Zhou Su; Zhongwu Zhai; Xiaoming Liu; Yudong Mei; Jianming Xu; Hongyan Tian; Chongyi Wang; Chi Chen; Yuan Yao; Zhiyuan Liu; Maosong Sun

name: FormFactory: An Interactive Benchmarking Suite for Multimodal Form-Filling Agents
summary: Introduces FormFactory, an interactive web-based benchmark for agents filling online forms, with varied field formats and evaluation of instruction-to-field alignment.
authors: Bobo Li; Yuheng Wang; Hao Fei; Juncheng Li; Wei Ji; Mong-Li Lee; Wynne Hsu

name: MLA-Trust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness of Multimodal LLM Agents in GUI Environments
summary: Benchmarks truthfulness, controllability, safety, and privacy of multimodal LLM agents across interactive web and mobile GUI tasks.
authors: Xiao Yang; Jiawei Chen; Jun Luo; Zhengwei Fang; Yinpeng Dong; Hang Su; Jun Zhu

name: WebChoreArena: Evaluating Web Browsing Agents on Realistic Tedious Web Tasks
summary: Introduces WebChoreArena, 532 web chores built on WebArena environments to evaluate agents’ retention of page information, calculation, and tracking across pages.
authors: Atsuyuki Miyai; Zaiying Zhao; Kazuki Egashira; Atsuki Sato; Tatsumi Sunada; Shota Onohara; Hiromasa Yamanishi; Mashiro Toyooka; Kunato Nishina; Ryoma Maeda; Kiyoharu Aizawa; Toshihiko Yamasaki

name: VPI-Bench: Visual Prompt Injection Attacks for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Introduces VPI-Bench, interactive web-platform variants containing visually embedded malicious instructions. It evaluates computer-use and browser-use agents under these threats and examines system-prompt defenses.
authors: Tri Cao; Bennett Lim; Yue Liu; Yuan Sui; Yuexin Li; Shumin Deng; Lin Lu; Nay Oo; Shuicheng Yan; Bryan Hooi

name: VerificAgent: Domain-Specific Memory Verification for Scalable Oversight of Aligned Computer-Use Agents
summary: Introduces VerificAgent, which grows domain-specific memories from task trajectories and subjects them to human fact-checking before deployment. Its OSWorld evaluation treats persistent memory as an auditable constraint on later agent behavior.
authors: Thong Q. Nguyen; Shubhang Desai; Raja Hasnain Anwar; Firoz Shaik; Vishwas Suryanarayanan; Vishal Chowdhary

name: DeepShop: A Benchmark for Deep Research Shopping Agents
summary: DeepShop evaluates shopping agents with evolving query complexity across product attributes, filters and sorting preferences. Its evaluation combines checks of these individual requirements with overall task success.
authors: Yougang Lyu; Xiaoyu Zhang; Lingyong Yan; Maarten de Rijke; Zhaochun Ren; Xiuying Chen

name: Surfer-H Meets Holo1: Cost-Efficient Web Agent Powered by Open Weights
summary: Describes Surfer-H, a web agent paired with the Holo1 vision-language model family trained on web content, synthetic examples, and agent-generated data. The work introduces WebClick for web-interface localization and evaluates browser task execution on WebVoyager.
authors: Mathieu Andreux; Breno Baldas Skuk; Hamza Benchekroun; Emilien Biré; Antoine Bonnet; Riaz Bordie; Nathan Bout; Matthias Brunel; Pierre-Louis Cedoz; Antoine Chassang; Mickaël Chen; Alexandra D. name: DPO Learning with LLMs-Judge Signal for Computer Use Agents
summary: Uses an LLM judge to evaluate and filter synthetic GUI interaction trajectories for training a compact vision-language agent. OSWorld experiments assess the policy designed for local execution.
authors: Man Luo; David Cobbley; Xin Su; Shachar Rosenman; Vasudev Lal; Shao-Yen Tseng; Phillip Howard

name: GUI-Actor: Coordinate-Free Visual Grounding for GUI Agents
summary: Uses an attention-based action head and a verifier to select relevant screen regions without generating coordinates as text.
authors: Qianhui Wu; Kanzhi Cheng; Rui Yang; Chaoyun Zhang; Jianwei Yang; Huiqiang Jiang; Jian Mu; Baolin Peng; Bo Qiao; Reuben Tan; Si Qin; Lars Liden; Qingwei Lin; Huan Zhang; Tong Zhang; Jianbing Zhang; Dongmei Zhang; Jianfeng Gao

name: Go-Browse: Training Web Agents with Structured Exploration
summary: Go-Browse frames web-environment exploration as graph search so that information can be reused across data-collection episodes. It collects 10,000 successful trajectories and 40,000 interaction steps on WebArena and uses them to fine-tune a web agent.
authors: Apurva Gandhi; Graham Neubig

name: MiMo-VL Technical Report
summary: Reports MiMo-VL-7B-SFT and MiMo-VL-7B-RL, general vision-language models trained with staged pre-training and mixed RL, with GUI grounding evaluated on OSWorld-G.
authors: Xiaomi LLM-Core Team; :; Zihao Yue; Zhenru Lin; Yifan Song; Weikun Wang; Shuhuai Ren; Shuhao Gu; Shicheng Li; Peidian Li; Liang Zhao; Lei Li; Kainan Bao; Hao Tian; Hailin Zhang; Gang Wang; Dawei Zhu; Cici; Chenhong He; Bowen Ye; Bowen Shen; Zihan Zhang; Zihan Jiang; Zhixian Zheng; Zhichao Song; Zhenbo Luo; Yue Yu; Yudong Wang; Yuanyuan Tian; Yu Tu; Yihan Yan; Yi Huang; Xu Wang; Xinzhe Xu; Xingchen Song; Xing Zhang; Xing Yong; Xin Zhang; Xiangwei Deng; Wenyu Yang; Wenhan Ma; Weiwei Lv; Weiji Zhuang; Wei Liu; Sirui Deng; Shuo Liu; Shimao Chen; Shihua Yu; Shaohui Liu; Shande Wang; Rui Ma; Qiantong Wang; Peng Wang; Nuo Chen; Menghang Zhu; Kangyang Zhou; Kang Zhou; Kai Fang; Jun Shi; Jinhao Dong; Jiebao Xiao; Jiaming Xu; Huaqiu Liu; Hongshen Xu; Heng Qu; Haochen Zhao; Hanglong Lv; Guoan Wang; Duo Zhang; Dong Zhang; Di Zhang; Chong Ma; Chang Liu; Can Cai; Bingquan Xia

name: macOSWorld: A Multilingual Interactive Benchmark for GUI Agents
summary: macOSWorld provides 202 interactive tasks across 30 applications, with instructions and operating-system interfaces in five languages. It evaluates GUI agents on macOS workflows and includes a separate subset for deception-attack testing.
authors: Pei Yang; Hai Ci; Mike Zheng Shou

name: Look Before You Leap: A GUI-Critic-R1 Model for Pre-Operative Error Diagnosis in GUI Automation
summary: Uses a pre-execution critic and reinforcement training to evaluate proposed GUI actions and provide corrective suggestions before execution.
authors: Yuyang Wanyan; Xi Zhang; Haiyang Xu; Haowei Liu; Junyang Wang; Jiabo Ye; Yutong Kou; Ming Yan; Fei Huang; Xiaoshan Yang; Weiming Dong; Changsheng Xu

name: Scenario-Guided LLM-based Mobile App GUI Testing
summary: ScenGen organizes mobile GUI testing around business scenarios. Five collaborating agents observe the interface, choose and execute actions, check scenario completion, and record operations and runtime bugs.
authors: Shengcheng Yu; Yuchen Ling; Chunrong Fang; Quan Zhou; Yi Zhao; Chunyang Chen; Shaomin Zhu; Zhenyu Chen

name: Deep Research Bench: Evaluating AI Web Research Agents
summary: Introduces Deep Research Bench, 89 multi-step web research tasks and a frozen collection of scraped pages for evaluating search agents and their traces over time.
authors: FutureSearch; :; Nikos I. Bosse; Jon Evans; Robert G. Gambee; Daniel Hnyk; Peter Mühlbacher; Lawrence Phillips; Dan Schwarz; Jack Wildman

name: BIMgent: Towards Autonomous Building Modeling via Computer-use Agents
summary: BIMgent plans software-specific workflows and executes GUI actions for building-information modeling. It evaluates multimodal building design and reconstruction tasks in professional authoring software.
authors: Zihan Deng; Changyu Du; Stavros Nousias; André Borrmann

name: GUIPilot: A Consistency-based Mobile GUI Testing Approach for Detecting Application-specific Bugs
summary: Introduces GUIPilot, which compares mobile design mock-ups with implemented screens through widget alignment and tests expected transitions by executing inferred UI actions. It evaluates both visual inconsistencies and workflow-specific bugs.
authors: Ruofan Liu; Xiwen Teoh; Yun Lin; Guanjie Chen; Ruofei Ren; Denys Poshyvanyk; Jin Song Dong

name: MCPWorld: A Unified Benchmarking Testbed for API, GUI, and Hybrid Computer Use Agents
summary: MCPWorld evaluates API, GUI, and hybrid computer-use agents with 201 tasks in applications whose source can be instrumented and extended with MCP support. It verifies completion from application behavior and packages the testbed in containers with GPU support.
authors: Yunhe Yan; Shihe Wang; Jiajun Du; Yexuan Yang; Yuxuan Shan; Qichen Qiu; Xianqing Jia; Xinge Wang; Xin Yuan; Xu Han; Mao Qin; Yinxiao Chen; Chen Peng; Shangguang Wang; Mengwei Xu

name: Thinking vs. Doing: Agents that Reason by Scaling Test-Time Interaction
summary: Test-Time Interaction scales the interaction horizon so web agents can explore, backtrack and revise plans within a rollout. Its online reinforcement-learning curriculum adjusts rollout lengths and is evaluated on WebVoyager and WebArena.
authors: Junhong Shen; Hao Bai; Lunjun Zhang; Yifei Zhou; Amrith Setlur; Shengbang Tong; Diego Caples; Nan Jiang; Tong Zhang; Ameet Talwalkar; Aviral Kumar

name: GUI-Reflection: Empowering Multimodal GUI Models with Self-Reflection Behavior
summary: GUI-Reflection synthesizes reflection and error-correction examples from successful trajectories and adds dedicated learning stages for these behaviors. It introduces a reflection task suite, a mobile environment for online data collection, and iterative reflection tuning.
authors: Penghao Wu; Shengnan Ma; Bo Wang; Jiaheng Yu; Lewei Lu; Ziwei Liu

name: EconWebArena: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents on Economic Tasks in Realistic Web Environments
summary: Introduces EconWebArena, a curated benchmark of economic-data tasks requiring live website navigation, multimodal interpretation, and precise extraction. It evaluates visual grounding, planning, and interaction design within multistep workflows.
authors: Zefang Liu; Yinzhu Quan

name: Atomic-to-Compositional Generalization for Mobile Agents with A New Benchmark and Scheduling System
summary: UI-NEXUS evaluates compositional mobile tasks in local utility apps and online Chinese and English service apps. AGENT-NEXUS decomposes those long tasks into self-contained atomic subtasks to study generalization beyond isolated screens or short action chains.
authors: Yuan Guo; Tingjia Miao; Zheng Wu; Pengzhou Cheng; Ming Zhou; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: LPO: Towards Accurate GUI Agent Interaction via Location Preference Optimization
summary: Location Preference Optimization uses an information-entropy signal to select interaction regions and a distance-based reward to assess click locations. It trains GUI localization through preference optimization and evaluates both offline grounding and online interaction.
authors: Jiaqi Tang; Yu Xia; Yi-Feng Wu; Yuwei Hu; Yuhui Chen; Qing-Guo Chen; Xiaogang Xu; Xiangyu Wu; Hao Lu; Yanqing Ma; Shiyin Lu; Qifeng Chen

name: Mirage-1: Augmenting and Updating GUI Agent with Hierarchical Multimodal Skills
summary: Mirage-1 organizes interaction trajectories into execution, core, and meta-skills, then uses them to guide Monte Carlo tree search during online GUI tasks. It introduces AndroidLH for long-horizon evaluation and tests the approach on Android and web-navigation benchmarks.
authors: Yuquan Xie; Zaijing Li; Rui Shao; Gongwei Chen; Kaiwen Zhou; Yinchuan Li; Dongmei Jiang; Liqiang Nie

name: Build the web for agents, not agents for the web
summary: Proposes Agentic Web Interface (AWI), a website interface intended for agent navigation, and sets out six design principles for web-agent use.
authors: Xing Han Lù; Gaurav Kamath; Marius Mosbach; Siva Reddy

name: UITron-Speech: Towards Automated GUI Agents Based on Speech Instructions
summary: Introduces UITron-Speech, which predicts GUI actions from spoken instructions and screenshots. It combines synthetic speech data and mixed-modality training with a training-free grounding refinement step.
authors: Wenkang Han; Zhixiong Zeng; Jing Huang; Shu Jiang; Liming Zheng; Longrong Yang; Haibo Qiu; Chang Yao; Jingyuan Chen; Lin Ma

name: Poison Once, Control Anywhere: Clean-Text Visual Backdoors in VLM-based Mobile Agents
summary: Demonstrates clean-text visual backdoor attacks (VIBMA) that compromise fine-tuned VLM mobile agents through visual triggers while keeping text instructions intact.
authors: Xuan Wang; Siyuan Liang; Zhe Liu; Yi Yu; Aishan Liu; Yuliang Lu; Xitong Gao; Ee-Chien Chang

name: FormGym: Doing Paperwork with Agents
summary: Introduces FormGym, a benchmark for filling image-only forms, and FieldFinder, a tool that helps LLMs locate where to place text on those forms.
authors: Matthew Toles; Rattandeep Singh; Isaac Song; Zhou Yu

name: AgentSynth: Scalable Task Generation for Generalist Computer-Use Agents
summary: AgentSynth composes easily generated subtasks into longer computer-use tasks and trajectories with adjustable difficulty. Its evaluation uses the number of subtasks to probe how agent success changes as task complexity grows.
authors: Jingxu Xie; Dylan Xu; Xuandong Zhao; Dawn Song

name: GUI-Robust: A Comprehensive Dataset for Testing GUI Agent Robustness in Real-World Anomalies
summary: Builds GUI task data with real-world interaction anomalies and evaluates how agent behavior changes under those conditions.
authors: Jingqi Yang; Zhilong Song; Jiawei Chen; Mingli Song; Sheng Zhou; linjun sun; Xiaogang Ouyang; Chun Chen; Can Wang

name: OS-Harm: A Benchmark for Measuring Safety of Computer Use Agents
summary: Extends OSWorld with tasks covering user misuse, prompt injection, and model misbehavior, with assessment of both task success and safety.
authors: Thomas Kuntz; Agatha Duzan; Hao Zhao; Francesco Croce; Zico Kolter; Nicolas Flammarion; Maksym Andriushchenko

name: Understanding GUI Agent Localization Biases through Logit Sharpness
summary: Introduces a finer-grained taxonomy of GUI localization errors and a logit-based Peak Sharpness Score for analyzing coordinate-prediction uncertainty. A context-aware cropping method refines the visual input without retraining the grounding model.
authors: Xingjian Tao; Yiwei Wang; Yujun Cai; Zhicheng Yang; Jing Tang

name: Embodied Web Agents: Bridging Physical-Digital Realms for Integrated Agent Intelligence
summary: Introduces environments that couple 3D physical-world simulations with functional web interfaces. The accompanying benchmark evaluates tasks requiring agents to coordinate online information and physical actions across cooking, navigation and shopping scenarios.
authors: Yining Hong; Rui Sun; Bingxuan Li; Xingcheng Yao; Maxine Wu; Alexander Chien; Da Yin; Ying Nian Wu; Zhecan James Wang; Kai-Wei Chang

name: OSWorld-Human: Benchmarking the Efficiency of Computer-Use Agents
summary: OSWorld-Human adds human-determined trajectories to OSWorld to evaluate the efficiency of desktop computer-use agents. The study compares 16 agents and analyzes model-call latency, changes in step duration during task execution, and excess action steps.
authors: Reyna Abhyankar; Qi Qi; Yiying Zhang

name: Context manipulation attacks : Web agents are susceptible to corrupted memory
summary: Studies context manipulation in web agents by altering stored task representations. Evaluation on Browser-use and Agent-E examines memory-directed attacks and the implications for secure context handling.
authors: Atharv Singh Patlan; Ashwin Hebbar; Pramod Viswanath; Prateek Mittal

name: Learning, Reasoning, Refinement: A Framework for Kahneman's Dual-System Intelligence in GUI Agents
summary: CogniGUI combines hierarchical visual parsing of interface elements with a GRPO-based grounding agent that compares alternative interaction paths. Its ScreenSeek benchmark evaluates navigation across applications, changing interface states, and consistency between interfaces.
authors: Jinjie Wei; Jiyao Liu; Lihao Liu; Ming Hu; Junzhi Ning; Mingcheng Li; Weijie Yin; Junjun He; Xiao Liang; Chao Feng; Dingkang Yang

name: Chain-of-Memory: Enhancing GUI Agents for Cross-Application Navigation
summary: Chain-of-Memory explicitly records action descriptions and task-relevant screen information in short- and long-term memory for GUI navigation. GUI Odyssey-CoM provides 111,000 screen-action pairs with memory annotations for learning and evaluating information retention across applications.
authors: Xinzge Gao; Chuanrui Hu; Bin Chen; Teng Li

name: Doc2Agent: Scalable Generation of Tool-Using Agents from API Documentation
summary: Introduces Doc2Agent, a pipeline that generates and refines Python tools from API documentation for tool-using agents, with WebArena APIs among its evaluations.
authors: Xinyi Ni; Haonan Jian; Qiuyang Wang; Vedanshi Chetan Shah; Pengyu Hong

name: Mobile-R1: Towards Interactive Capability for VLM-Based Mobile Agent via Systematic Training
summary: Uses a staged curriculum from response-format alignment through action feedback to interactive task-level training for mobile agents.
authors: Jihao Gu; Qihang Ai; Yingyao Wang; Pi Bu; Jingxuan Xing; Zekun Zhu; Wei Jiang; Ziming Wang; Yingxiu Zhao; Ming-Liang Zhang; Jun Song; Yuning Jiang; Bo Zheng

name: Agent-RewardBench: Towards a Unified Benchmark for Reward Modeling across Perception, Planning, and Safety in Real-World Multimodal Agents
summary: Introduces Agent-RewardBench to evaluate step-level reward models for multimodal agents across perception, planning, and safety; web navigation is among its scenarios.
authors: Tianyi Men; Zhuoran Jin; Pengfei Cao; Yubo Chen; Kang Liu; Jun Zhao

name: Mind2Web 2: Evaluating Agentic Search with Agent-as-a-Judge
summary: Introduces Mind2Web 2, 130 long-horizon tasks requiring live web browsing and information synthesis, plus an Agent-as-a-Judge framework for grading answers and sources.
authors: Boyu Gou; Zanming Huang; Yuting Ning; Yu Gu; Michael Lin; Weijian Qi; Andrei Kopanev; Botao Yu; Bernal Jiménez Gutiérrez; Yiheng Shu; Chan Hee Song; Jiaman Wu; Shijie Chen; Hanane Nour Moussa; Tianshu Zhang; Jian Xie; Yifei Li; Tianci Xue; Zeyi Liao; Kai Zhang; Boyuan Zheng; Zhaowei Cai; Viktor Rozgic; Morteza Ziyadi; Huan Sun; Yu Su

name: ZonUI-3B: A Lightweight Vision-Language Model for Cross-Resolution GUI Grounding
summary: ZonUI-3B trains GUI grounding with a curated 24,000-example collection of mobile, desktop, and web screenshots. Its two-stage procedure first learns across platforms and then specializes on high-resolution images, with ablations on data diversity and redundant examples.
authors: ZongHan Hsieh; Tzer-Jen Wei; ShengJing Yang

name: DiMo-GUI: Advancing Test-time Scaling in GUI Grounding via Modality-Aware Visual Reasoning
summary: Separates textual and iconic UI elements and iteratively focuses visual regions to refine grounding without additional model training.
authors: Hang Wu; Hongkai Chen; Yujun Cai; Chang Liu; Qingwen Ye; Ming-Hsuan Yang; Yiwei Wang

name: LineRetriever: Planning-Aware Observation Reduction for Web Agents
summary: LineRetriever uses a language model to select observation lines that matter for upcoming web-navigation actions. It reduces DOM or accessibility-tree context by considering the planning horizon.
authors: Imene Kerboua; Sahar Omidi Shayegan; Megh Thakkar; Xing Han Lù; Massimo Caccia; Véronique Eglin; Alexandre Aussem; Jérémy Espinas; Alexandre Lacoste

name: SafeMobile: Chain-level Jailbreak Detection and Automated Evaluation for Multimodal Mobile Agents
summary: Studies chain-level risk detection for mobile multimodal agents and a language-model-assisted evaluator, assessing safety interventions together with functional preservation.
authors: Siyuan Liang; Tianmeng Fang; Zhe Liu; Aishan Liu; Yan Xiao; Jinyuan He; Ee-Chien Chang; Xiaochun Cao

name: WebArxiv: A Reproducible Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Web Agents on arXiv Tasks
summary: WebArxiv provides 510 static-snapshot tasks with deterministic answers for scholarly browsing, including constrained paper retrieval, content extraction, and cross-paper comparison. The study also tests dynamic retrieval of interaction history to address repetitive or incomplete agent reasoning.
authors: Zihao Sun; Zijing Shi; Ling Chen

name: GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking: Towards Versatile Multimodal Reasoning with Scalable Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reports the GLM-4.1V-Thinking, GLM-4.5V, and GLM-4.6V vision-language model family and curriculum-based RL training, with GUI agents among its evaluated tasks.

name: Less is More: Empowering GUI Agent with Context-Aware Simplification
summary: SimpAgent prunes distracting interface elements with visual masks and compresses interaction history using consistency-based guidance. The study evaluates these two forms of context reduction during GUI navigation in web and mobile environments.
authors: Gongwei Chen; Xurui Zhou; Rui Shao; Yibo Lyu; Kaiwen Zhou; Shuai Wang; Wentao Li; Yinchuan Li; Zhongang Qi; Liqiang Nie

name: How to Train Your LLM Web Agent: A Statistical Diagnosis
summary: Studies compute allocation for web-agent post-training with teacher-generated supervised fine-tuning followed by on-policy reinforcement learning. It samples 1,370 training configurations and uses bootstrap analysis to examine hyperparameter sensitivity on WorkArena and MiniWoB++.
authors: Dheeraj Vattikonda; Santhoshi Ravichandran; Emiliano Penaloza; Hadi Nekoei; Megh Thakkar; Thibault Le Sellier de Chezelles; Nicolas Gontier; Miguel Muñoz-Mármol; Sahar Omidi Shayegan; Stefania Raimondo; Xue Liu; Alexandre Drouin; Laurent Charlin; Alexandre Piché; Alexandre Lacoste; Massimo Caccia

name: Mobile GUI Agents under Real-world Threats: Are We There Yet?
summary: Introduces an app-content instrumentation framework and complementary interactive and static test suites for mobile GUI agents. It studies how untrusted third-party content changes task execution and state understanding.
authors: Guohong Liu; Jialei Ye; Jiacheng Liu; Yuanchun Li; Wei Liu; Pengzhi Gao; Jian Luan; Yunxin Liu

name: WebSynthesis: World-Model-Guided MCTS for Efficient WebUI-Trajectory Synthesis
summary: Introduces WebSynthesis, which uses a learned web world model and tree-based planning to synthesize interaction trajectories for training web agents.
authors: Yifei Gao; Junhong Ye; Jiaqi Wang; Jitao Sang

name: A Systematization of Security Vulnerabilities in Computer Use Agents
summary: Analyzes security boundaries in computer-use agents through a risk taxonomy and concrete adversarial case studies. It links observed failures to input provenance, interface-action binding, memory, and delegation, and proposes CUA-specific evaluation principles.
authors: Daniel Jones; Giorgio Severi; Martin Pouliot; Gary Lopez; Joris de Gruyter; Santiago Zanella-Beguelin; Justin Song; Blake Bullwinkel; Pamela Cortez; Amanda Minnich

name: R-VLM: Region-Aware Vision Language Model for Precise GUI Grounding
summary: R-VLM localizes GUI elements through zoomed-in region proposals and an intersection-over-union-aware training objective. It evaluates the grounding model on ScreenSpot and AgentStudio and studies its effect on navigation in AITW and Mind2Web.
authors: Joonhyung Park; Peng Tang; Sagnik Das; Srikar Appalaraju; Kunwar Yashraj Singh; R. Manmatha; Shabnam Ghadar

name: MobileGUI-RL: Advancing Mobile GUI Agent through Reinforcement Learning in Online Environment
summary: MobileGUI-RL constructs an online training curriculum through agent exploration and task filtering. It adapts GRPO with trajectory-aware advantages and rewards for task completion and execution efficiency, evaluated on three online mobile-agent benchmarks.
authors: Yucheng Shi; Wenhao Yu; Zaitang Li; Yonglin Wang; Hongming Zhang; Ninghao Liu; Haitao Mi; Dong Yu

name: GTA1: GUI Test-time Scaling Agent
summary: GTA1 samples multiple action proposals at each GUI step and uses a judge to select among them. A separate grounding model is trained with reinforcement learning to map selected proposals to visual targets, linking planning-time search with click localization.
authors: Yan Yang; Dongxu Li; Yutong Dai; Yuhao Yang; Ziyang Luo; Zirui Zhao; Zhiyuan Hu; Junzhe Huang; Amrita Saha; Zeyuan Chen; Ran Xu; Liyuan Pan; Silvio Savarese; Caiming Xiong; Junnan Li

name: OpenAgentSafety: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Real-World AI Agent Safety
summary: Evaluates agent safety across real browser, code, filesystem, shell, and messaging tools using rule-based and model-based assessments.
authors: Sanidhya Vijayvargiya; Aditya Bharat Soni; Xuhui Zhou; Zora Zhiruo Wang; Nouha Dziri; Graham Neubig; Maarten Sap

name: VisualTrap: A Stealthy Backdoor Attack on GUI Agents via Visual Grounding Manipulation
summary: Studies backdoors that redirect GUI visual grounding even when the task plan is correct. VisualTrap evaluates whether poisoned grounding training transfers to downstream tasks and across web, mobile, and desktop interface settings.
authors: Ziang Ye; Yang Zhang; Wentao Shi; Xiaoyu You; Fuli Feng; Tat-Seng Chua

name: A Training-Free, Task-Agnostic Framework for Enhancing MLLM Performance on High-Resolution Images

name: LaSM: Layer-wise Scaling Mechanism for Defending Pop-up Attack on GUI Agents
summary: Introduces LaSM, a training-free defense that selectively scales attention and MLP components to improve alignment with task-relevant screen regions. It evaluates the approach against pop-up-based GUI injection attacks.

name: Machine-Readable Ads: Accessibility and Trust Patterns for AI Web Agents interacting with Online Advertisements
summary: Compares DOM-based and pixel-based web agents on a cloned news site containing advertisements, consent dialogs and paywalls. The study examines how interface presentation affects ad interaction and consequential subscription choices.
authors: Joel Nitu; Heidrun Mühle; Andreas Stöckl

name: WebGuard: Building a Generalizable Guardrail for Web Agents
summary: Introduces WebGuard, a human-annotated dataset for predicting outcomes and risk levels of state-changing website actions. It provides generalization splits and evaluates specialized guardrail models.

name: Manipulating LLM Web Agents with Indirect Prompt Injection Attack via HTML Accessibility Tree
summary: Studies indirect prompt injection through HTML content consumed as accessibility trees. The evaluation tests how manipulated page observations redirect browser-agent actions on real websites.

name: GUI-G$^2$: Gaussian Reward Modeling for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI-G2 replaces binary grounding rewards with Gaussian point rewards and spatial-coverage rewards. An adaptive variance tied to element dimensions supplies continuous training feedback for targets of different sizes, evaluated on the ScreenSpot benchmark family.

name: Screen2AX: Vision-Based Approach for Automatic macOS Accessibility Generation
summary: Introduces Screen2AX, which creates hierarchical accessibility metadata from macOS screenshots, plus datasets and Screen2AX-Task for desktop-agent evaluation.
authors: Viktor Muryn; Marta Sumyk; Mariya Hirna; Sofiya Garkot; Maksym Shamrai

name: MobileUse: A GUI Agent with Hierarchical Reflection for Autonomous Mobile Operation
summary: MobileUse reflects on errors at action and task timescales, invoking reflection when needed and using proactive exploration to learn unfamiliar apps. It evaluates this mobile execution framework on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab and describes a toolkit for physical-device operation.
authors: Ning Li; Xiangmou Qu; Jiamu Zhou; Jun Wang; Muning Wen; Kounianhua Du; Xingyu Lou; Qiuying Peng; Jun Wang; Weinan Zhang

name: ProactiveVA: Proactive Visual Analytics with LLM-Based UI Agent
summary: Studies proactive assistance in visual-analytics interfaces, using interaction logs to detect support needs and provide context-aware suggestions and guidance.
authors: Yuheng Zhao; Xueli Shu; Liwen Fan; Lin Gao; Yu Zhang; Siming Chen

name: OS-MAP: How Far Can Computer-Using Agents Go in Breadth and Depth?
summary: OS-MAP organizes 416 computer-use tasks across 15 applications by a five-level automation taxonomy and a hierarchy of user demands. The benchmark separates required autonomy from generalization scope to diagnose where agents struggle as task demands increase.
authors: Xuetian Chen; Yinghao Chen; Xinfeng Yuan; Zhuo Peng; Lu Chen; Yuekeng Li; Zhoujia Zhang; Yingqian Huang; Leyan Huang; Jiaqing Liang; Tianbao Xie; Zhiyong Wu; Qiushi Sun; Biqing Qi; Bowen Zhou

name: MMBench-GUI: Hierarchical Multi-Platform Evaluation Framework for GUI Agents
summary: MMBench-GUI evaluates interface understanding, element grounding, task automation, and collaboration across six named desktop, mobile, and web platforms. It introduces the Efficiency-Quality Area metric for examining execution efficiency alongside task quality in online GUI automation.
authors: Xuehui Wang; Zhenyu Wu; JingJing Xie; Zichen Ding; Bowen Yang; Zehao Li; Zhaoyang Liu; Qingyun Li; Xuan Dong; Zhe Chen; Weiyun Wang; Xiangyu Zhao; Jixuan Chen; Haodong Duan; Tianbao Xie; Chenyu Yang; Shiqian Su; Yue Yu; Yuan Huang; Yiqian Liu; Xiao Zhang; Yanting Zhang; Xiangyu Yue; Weijie Su; Xizhou Zhu; Wei Shen; Jifeng Dai; Wenhai Wang

name: FingerTip 20K: A Benchmark for Proactive and Personalized Mobile LLM Agents
summary: FingerTip 20K gathers 20K human Android demonstrations from users' long-term everyday app use, with user context, to evaluate proactive task suggestion and preference-aware task execution.
authors: Qinglong Yang; Haoming Li; Haotian Zhao; Xiaokai Yan; Jingtao Ding; Fengli Xu; Yong Li

name: MapAgent: Trajectory-Constructed Memory-Augmented Planning for Mobile Task Automation
summary: Builds reusable page memories from past mobile trajectories and retrieves them to support task planning and execution.
authors: Yi Kong; Dianxi Shi; Guoli Yang; Zhang ke-di; Chenlin Huang; Xiaopeng Li; Songchang Jin

name: UI-AGILE: Advancing GUI Agents with Effective Reinforcement Learning and Precise Inference-Time Grounding
summary: Combines grounding-oriented reward and sampling improvements with inference-time image decomposition and target selection.

name: Magentic-UI: Towards Human-in-the-loop Agentic Systems
summary: Magentic-UI combines browser interaction, code execution, file operations, and MCP tools in an interface for human-agent collaboration. It studies collaborative planning and task execution, action guards, and persistent memory through benchmark tasks, simulated users, user studies, and safety assessments.
authors: Hussein Mozannar; Gagan Bansal; Cheng Tan; Adam Fourney; Victor Dibia; Jingya Chen; Jack Gerrits; Tyler Payne; Matheus Kunzler Maldaner; Madeleine Grunde-McLaughlin; Eric Zhu; Griffin Bassman; Jacob Alber; Peter Chang; Ricky Loynd; Friederike Niedtner; Ece Kamar; Maya Murad; Rafah Hosn; Saleema Amershi

summary: Introduces SiRA, an agent architecture that uses a language-based world model to simulate action outcomes for planning in web-browser tasks.

name: Phi-Ground Tech Report: Advancing Perception in GUI Grounding
summary: Reports a GUI-grounding model family and empirical design choices covering source data, perception training, and coordinate prediction.
authors: Miaosen Zhang; Ziqiang Xu; Jialiang Zhu; Qi Dai; Kai Qiu; Yifan Yang; Chong Luo; Tianyi Chen; Justin Wagle; Tim Franklin; Baining Guo

name: Measuring Harmfulness of Computer-Using Agents
summary: Introduces CUAHarm, 104 computer-use misuse tasks in a sandbox with verifiable rewards, and studies whether language models can monitor unsafe agent actions.
authors: Aaron Xuxiang Tian; Ruofan Zhang; Janet Tang; Ji Wang; Tianyu Shi; Jiaxin Wen

name: NaturalGAIA: A Verifiable Benchmark and Hierarchical Framework for Long-Horizon GUI Tasks
summary: NaturalGAIA builds verifiable long-horizon GUI tasks from human interaction intents while separating causal task structure from its verbal description. Its LightManus-Jarvis framework divides dynamic planning and context management from execution based on visual and structural interface information.
authors: Zihan Zheng; Tianle Cui; Taoran Wang; Fengtao Wang; Jiahui Pan; Lewei He; Qianglong Chen

name: Web-CogReasoner: Towards Multimodal Knowledge-Induced Cognitive Reasoning for Web Agents
summary: Web-CogReasoner separates factual and conceptual web knowledge from procedural reasoning, using a structured curriculum to train a multimodal agent. Web-CogDataset and Web-CogBench support study of these capabilities alongside web-navigation evaluation.
authors: Yuhan Guo; Cong Guo; Aiwen Sun; Hongliang He; Xinyu Yang; Yue Lu; Yingji Zhang; Xuntao Guo; Dong Zhang; Jianzhuang Liu; Jiang Duan; Yijia Xiao; Liangjian Wen; Hai-Ming Xu; Yong Dai

name: NaviMaster: Learning a Unified Policy for GUI and Embodied Navigation Tasks
summary: NaviMaster trains a shared policy for GUI and embodied navigation using a common visual-trajectory formulation. It combines trajectory collection, reinforcement learning and distance-aware rewards, with evaluation across both task families.

name: MagicGUI: A Foundational Mobile GUI Agent with Scalable Data Pipeline and Reinforcement Fine-tuning
summary: Combines a mobile GUI data pipeline, perception and planning capabilities, and reinforcement fine-tuning for interactive task execution.
authors: Liujian Tang; Shaokang Dong; Yijia Huang; Minqi Xiang; Hongtao Ruan; Bin Wang; Shuo Li; Zhiheng Xi; Zhihui Cao; Hailiang Pang; Heng Kong; He Yang; Mingxu Chai; Zhilin Gao; Xingyu Liu; Yingnan Fu; Jiaming Liu; Xuanjing Huang; Yu-Gang Jiang; Tao Gui; Qi Zhang; Kang Wang; Yunke Zhang; Yuran Wang

name: HarmonyGuard: Toward Safety and Utility in Web Agents via Adaptive Policy Enhancement and Dual-Objective Optimization
summary: Introduces HarmonyGuard, a multi-agent framework that updates security policies and weighs safety against task completion for agents operating on the open web.
authors: Yurun Chen; Xavier Hu; Yuhan Liu; Keting Yin; Juncheng Li; Zhuosheng Zhang; Shengyu Zhang

name: Uncertainty-Aware GUI Agent: Adaptive Perception through Component Recommendation and Human-in-the-Loop Refinement
summary: RecAgent narrows attention to recommended UI components and requests user feedback when task intent or decisions remain uncertain. It introduces ComplexAction to evaluate specified single-step GUI actions in difficult interface scenarios.
authors: Chao Hao; Shuai Wang; Kaiwen Zhou

name: VeriWeb: Verifiable Long-Chain Web Benchmark for Agentic Information-Seeking
summary: Introduces VeriWeb, a benchmark of long-chain web information-seeking tasks with verifiable subtasks and a complete human-annotated trajectory for each task.
authors: Shunyu Liu; Minghao Liu; Huichi Zhou; Zhenyu Cui; Yang Zhou; Yuhao Zhou; Jialiang Gao; Heng Zhou; Yunhao Yang; Wendong Fan; puzhen zhang; Ge Zhang; Jiajun Shi; Weihao Xuan; Jiaxing Huang; Shuang Luo; Fang Wu; Heli Qi; Qingcheng Zeng; Junjie Wang; Aosong Feng; Jindi Lv; Sicong Jiang; Ziqi Ren; Wangchunshu Zhou; Zhenfei Yin; Wenlong Zhang; Guohao Li; Wenhao Yu; Lei Ma; Lei Bai; Qunshu Lin; Mingli Song; Dacheng Tao

name: Evolving in Tasks: Empowering the Multi-modality Large Language Model as the Computer Use Agent
summary: The Self-Evolution Agent combines automatic generation of verifiable computer-use trajectories with step-wise reinforcement learning for long-horizon training. It also describes a model-enhancement procedure that integrates grounding and planning capabilities without an additional training stage.
authors: Yuhao Cheng; Liang Tang; Shuxian Li; Yukang Huo; Tiaonan Duan; Kaer Huang; Yanzhe Jing; Yiqiang Yan

name: GuirlVG: Incentivize GUI Visual Grounding via Empirical Exploration on Reinforcement Learning
summary: Introduces GuirlVG, an empirical study of reinforcement fine-tuning for GUI visual grounding. It analyzes training components and adds an adaptive KL-based mechanism to limit reward over-optimization.
authors: Weitai Kang; Bin Lei; Gaowen Liu; Caiwen Ding; Yan Yan

name: Beyond Pixels: Exploring DOM Downsampling for LLM-Based Web Agents
summary: D2Snap reduces serialized DOM observations while preserving actionable elements and features that distinguish their uses. The study compares reduced DOM inputs with screenshot-based observations for a web agent on tasks sampled from Online-Mind2Web.
authors: Thassilo M. Schiepanski; Nicholas Piël

name: OS Agents: A Survey on MLLM-based Agents for General Computing Devices Use
summary: Surveys agents that operate computers and phones through operating-system interfaces, covering components, capabilities, foundation models, frameworks, and benchmarks.
authors: Xueyu Hu; Tao Xiong; Biao Yi; Zishu Wei; Ruixuan Xiao; Yurun Chen; Jiasheng Ye; Meiling Tao; Xiangxin Zhou; Ziyu Zhao; Yuhuai Li; Shengze Xu; Shenzhi Wang; Xinchen Xu; Shuofei Qiao; Zhaokai Wang; Kun Kuang; Tieyong Zeng; Liang Wang; Jiwei Li; Yuchen Eleanor Jiang; Wangchunshu Zhou; Guoyin Wang; Keting Yin; Zhou Zhao; Hongxia Yang; Fan Wu; Shengyu Zhang; Fei Wu

name: SEAgent: Self-Evolving Computer Use Agent with Autonomous Learning from Experience
summary: SEAgent explores unfamiliar software using a world-state assessor and an automatically generated task curriculum. It learns from failed and successful interactions through adversarial imitation and GRPO, then combines specialist experience into a generalist agent evaluated on five OSWorld software environments.
authors: Zeyi Sun; Ziyu Liu; Yuhang Zang; Yuhang Cao; Xiaoyi Dong; Tong Wu; Dahua Lin; Jiaqi Wang

summary: Introduces CogniWeb, which switches between fast reactive processing and slower deliberative reasoning according to task complexity. WebArena experiments examine this combination of learned behaviors and online planning.

name: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding via Region Consistency
summary: GUI-RC aggregates multiple grounding predictions into spatial voting grids to choose a consensus region. GUI-RCPO then turns agreement with that region into a reward for test-time policy updates on unlabeled GUI screenshots.

name: InfiGUI-G1: Advancing GUI Grounding with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization
summary: Uses multiple candidate answers and adaptive exploration rewards to improve spatial and semantic alignment in GUI grounding.
authors: Yuhang Liu; Zeyu Liu; Shuanghe Zhu; Pengxiang Li; Congkai Xie; Jiasheng Wang; Xavier Hu; Xiaotian Han; Jianbo Yuan; Xinyao Wang; Shengyu Zhang; Hongxia Yang; Fei Wu

name: MVISU-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Agents for Real-World Tasks by Multi-App, Vague, Interactive, Single-App and Unethical Instructions

authors: Weixuan Wang; Dongge Han; Daniel Madrigal Diaz; Jin Xu; Victor Rühle; Saravan Rajmohan

name: FineState-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Fine-Grained State Control in GUI Agents
summary: FineState-Bench evaluates fine-grained GUI perception and control across desktop, web, and mobile interfaces. Its Visual Diagnostic Assistant separates perception and localization contributions in controlled interaction experiments.

summary: Studies screenshot-based GUI grounding and navigation using curated interaction data, reward design, and reinforcement fine-tuning.

summary: WebMall provides four simulated online shops with heterogeneous product data for comparison shopping, related-product searches, and checkout tasks. It evaluates web agents with different observation formats and memory configurations in a fixed offline environment.

name: MM-BrowseComp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Browsing Agents
summary: Introduces MM-BrowseComp, a benchmark for browsing agents that must use evidence from web images and videos to answer multimodal search questions.
authors: Shilong Li; Xingyuan Bu; Wenjie Wang; Jiaheng Liu; Jun Dong; Haoyang He; Hao Lu; Haozhe Zhang; Chenchen Jing; Zhen Li; Chuanhao Li; Jiayi Tian; Chenchen Zhang; Tianhao Peng; Yancheng He; Jihao Gu; Hui Huang; Donghao Zhou; Yuanxing Zhang; Jian Yang; Ge Zhang; Wenhao Huang; Zhaoxiang Zhang; Qiangpeng Yang; Shilei Wen

name: You Don't Know Until You Click:Automated GUI Testing for Production-Ready Software Evaluation
summary: RealDevWorld evaluates generated software repositories with 194 development tasks and AppEvalPilot, an agent judge that operates the resulting GUIs. The evaluation examines functional behavior, visual fidelity, and runtime responses to produce task-specific diagnostic feedback.

summary: Amazon-Bench generates functionality-specific web tasks from page content and interactive controls, covering operations beyond product search. Its evaluator checks task completion and unintended changes to account state, such as address or purchase settings.

summary: Introduces IAML training, which augments coordinate samples to help multimodal models locate GUI elements from screen content and user instructions.

name: WebMMU: A Benchmark for Multimodal Multilingual Website Understanding and Code Generation
summary: Introduces WebMMU, a multilingual benchmark for website visual question answering, element grounding, code editing, and mockup-to-code generation.

name: WebSight: A Vision-First Architecture for Robust Web Agents
summary: WebSight uses a vision-language model trained on web-interface examples within a modular agent with planning, action, verification, and episodic memory components. It evaluates element clicking on Showdown Clicks and full browsing tasks on WebVoyager using visual observations.

name: DashboardQA: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Question Answering on Interactive Dashboards
summary: Introduces DashboardQA to evaluate how vision-language GUI agents answer questions by interacting with dashboards, grounding elements, and planning actions.

summary: Introduces PerPilot and the PerInstruct dataset for completing user-specific mobile instructions through memory retrieval, app exploration, and clarification when missing context remains unresolved.

summary: Proposes a proactive GUI assistant that gathers information across domains in response to user requests and anticipated information needs.

summary: Introduces SAPA-Bench with 7,138 smartphone scenarios to evaluate whether MLLM-powered mobile agents detect and protect sensitive personal information on screen.

name: InquireMobile: Teaching VLM-based Mobile Agent to Request Human Assistance via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
summary: InquireMobile trains mobile agents to seek human confirmation at critical decisions using staged reinforcement fine-tuning and pre-action reasoning. InquireBench evaluates safe interaction and proactive inquiry, distinguishing asking for help from completing the underlying task.

summary: Introduces Morae, a UI agent that detects decision points and pauses for user choices using interface code and screenshots. A study with blind and low-vision participants evaluates this mixed-initiative approach on real web tasks.

name: MMSearch-Plus: Benchmarking Provenance-Aware Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents
summary: Introduces MMSearch-Plus, a multimodal browsing benchmark with iterative image-text search, and an agent framework that marks and crops images for targeted retrieval.

name: MobiAgent: A Systematic Framework for Customizable Mobile Agents
summary: Presents MobiAgent, combining MobiMind agent models, the AgentRR acceleration framework, and MobiFlow evaluation. It also introduces an AI-assisted data-collection pipeline for mobile GUI tasks.
authors: Cheng Zhang; Erhu Feng; Xi Zhao; Yisheng Zhao; Wangbo Gong; Jiahui Sun; Dong Du; Zhichao Hua; Yubin Xia; Haibo Chen

name: FlashAdventure: A Benchmark for GUI Agents Solving Full Story Arcs in Diverse Adventure Games
summary: FlashAdventure evaluates GUI agents on completing story arcs in 34 adventure games. It pairs an automated gameplay judge with COAST, a framework that keeps long-term clue memory to plan and complete sequential objectives.
authors: Jaewoo Ahn; Junseo Kim; Heeseung Yun; Jaehyeon Son; Dongmin Park; Jaewoong Cho; Gunhee Kim

name: Throttling Web Agents Using Reasoning Gates
summary: Introduces reasoning gates that require agents to solve generated, verifiable puzzles before receiving access to resources. The throttling approach is deployed on a custom website and MCP servers and evaluated with web agents.
authors: Abhinav Kumar; Jaechul Roh; Ali Naseh; Amir Houmansadr; Eugene Bagdasarian

name: Succeed or Learn Slowly: Sample Efficient Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Mobile App Control
summary: Succeed or Learn Slowly applies direct off-policy updates to successful interactions and more conservative regularized updates to negative examples. Successful Transition Replay prioritizes successful experience during policy learning, with evaluation on AndroidWorld.
authors: Georgios Papoudakis; Thomas Coste; Jianye Hao; Jun Wang; Kun Shao

name: OmniActor: A Generalist GUI and Embodied Agent for 2D&3D Worlds
summary: Introduces OmniActor, which shares shallow model layers while separating deeper parameters to train jointly on GUI and embodied interactions. A unified action representation and mixed training data support evaluation in both task families.
authors: Longrong Yang; Zhixiong Zeng; Yufeng Zhong; Jing Huang; Liming Zheng; Lei Chen; Haibo Qiu; Zequn Qin; Lin Ma; Xi Li

name: AppCopilot: Toward General, Accurate, Long-Horizon, and Efficient Mobile Agent
summary: Describes a mobile-agent stack combining region-based coordinate correction, hierarchical task planning, multi-agent voting, and reuse of successful interaction traces.
authors: Jingru Fan; Yufan Dang; Jingyao Wu; Huatao Li; Runde Yang; Xiyuan Yang; Yuheng Wang; Chen Qian

name: UI-TARS-2 Technical Report: Advancing GUI Agent with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
summary: UI-TARS-2 combines scalable trajectory generation, stabilized multi-turn reinforcement learning, and a sandbox that supports GUI, filesystem, and terminal actions. The report evaluates the resulting agent across web, desktop, Android, and game tasks and analyzes training stability.
authors: Haoming Wang; Haoyang Zou; Huatong Song; Jiazhan Feng; Junjie Fang; Junting Lu; Longxiang Liu; Qinyu Luo; Shihao Liang; Shijue Huang; Wanjun Zhong; Yining Ye; Yujia Qin; Yuwen Xiong; Yuxin Song; Zhiyong Wu; Aoyan Li; Bo Li; Chen Dun; Chong Liu; Daoguang Zan; Fuxing Leng; Hanbin Wang; Hao Yu; Haobin Chen; Hongyi Guo; Jing Su; Jingjia Huang; Kai Shen; Kaiyu Shi; Lin Yan; Peiyao Zhao; Pengfei Liu; Qinghao Ye; Renjie Zheng; Shulin Xin; Wayne Xin Zhao; Wen Heng; Wenhao Huang; Wenqian Wang; Xiaobo Qin; Yi Lin; Youbin Wu; Zehui Chen; Zihao Wang; Baoquan Zhong; Xinchun Zhang; Xujing Li; Yuanfan Li; Zhongkai Zhao; Chengquan Jiang; Faming Wu; Haotian Zhou; Jinlin Pang; Li Han; Qi Liu; Qianli Ma; Siyao Liu; Songhua Cai; Wenqi Fu; Xin Liu; Yaohui Wang; Zhi Zhang; Bo Zhou; Guoliang Li; Jiajun Shi; Jiale Yang; Jie Tang; Li Li; Qihua Han; Taoran Lu; Woyu Lin; Xiaokang Tong; Xinyao Li; Yichi Zhang; Yu Miao; Zhengxuan Jiang; Zili Li; Ziyuan Zhao; Chenxin Li; Dehua Ma; Feng Lin; Ge Zhang; Haihua Yang; Hangyu Guo; Hongda Zhu; Jiaheng Liu; Junda Du; Kai Cai; Kuanye Li; Lichen Yuan; Meilan Han; Minchao Wang; Shuyue Guo; Tianhao Cheng; Xiaobo Ma; Xiaojun Xiao; Xiaolong Huang; Xinjie Chen; Yidi Du; Yilin Chen; Yiwen Wang; Zhaojian Li; Zhenzhu Yang; Zhiyuan Zeng; Chaolin Jin; Chen Li; Hao Chen; Haoli Chen; Jian Chen; Qinghao Zhao; Guang Shi

name: PG-Agent: An Agent Powered by Page Graph
summary: Introduces PG-Agent, which turns GUI operation episodes into page graphs and retrieves guidance from them to support task decomposition in new scenarios.
authors: Weizhi Chen; Ziwei Wang; Leyang Yang; Sheng Zhou; Xiaoxuan Tang; Jiajun Bu; Yong Li; Wei Jiang

name: MobileRAG: Enhancing Mobile Agent with Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: MobileRAG combines retrieval and memory components to support mobile tasks that need external knowledge or long action sequences. MobileRAG-Eval is introduced to study these requirements on complex real-world app tasks.
authors: Gowen Loo; Chang Liu; Qinghong Yin; Xiang Chen; Jiawei Chen; Jingyuan Zhang; Yu Tian

name: Are LLM Agents the New RPA? A Comparative Study with RPA Across Enterprise Workflows
summary: Compares an agent using computer interfaces with UiPath RPA on enterprise data entry, monitoring, and document extraction, measuring speed, reliability, and development effort.
authors: Petr Průcha; Michaela Matoušková; Jan Strnad

name: Learning Active Perception via Self-Evolving Preference Optimization for GUI Grounding
summary: LASER builds preference data for multi-step GUI perception by combining Monte Carlo quality estimates with region-overlap evaluation. Its self-evolving training encourages relevant region selection and adapts the amount of reasoning before predicting screen coordinates.
authors: Wanfu Wang; Qipeng Huang; Guangquan Xue; Xiaobo Liang; Juntao Li

name: SparkUI-Parser: Enhancing GUI Perception with Robust Grounding and Parsing
summary: Introduces SparkUI-Parser, which adds continuous coordinate decoding and a rejection mechanism for nonexistent targets to a multimodal model. It also presents ScreenParse for evaluating structural interface perception.
authors: Hongyi Jing; Jiafu Chen; Chen Rao; Ziqiang Dang; Jiajie Teng; Tianyi Chu; Juncheng Mo; Shuo Fang; Huaizhong Lin; Rui Lv; Chenguang Ma; Lei Zhao

name: MAS-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Shortcut-Augmented Hybrid Mobile GUI Agents
summary: MAS-Bench evaluates mobile agents that combine GUI actions with APIs, deep links, and reusable scripts. Its 139 tasks across 11 apps test use of 88 predefined shortcuts as well as the ability to generate new reusable workflows.
authors: Pengxiang Zhao; Guangyi Liu; YaoZhen Liang; Weiqing He; Zhengxi Lu; WenHao Wang; Yuehao Huang; Yuxiang Chai; Zhaolu Kang; Yaxuan Guo; Hao Wang; Kexin Zhang; Liang Liu; Yong Liu

name: Instruction Agent: Enhancing Agent with Expert Demonstration
summary: Introduces Instruction Agent, a GUI agent that follows instructions extracted from one expert demonstration and uses verification and backtracking to handle interruptions.
authors: Yinheng Li; Hailey Hultquist; Justin Wagle; Kazuhito Koishida

name: VeriOS: Query-Driven Proactive Human-Agent-GUI Interaction for Trustworthy OS Agents
summary: Introduces VeriOS-Agent, which learns when to execute GUI actions autonomously and when to query a user under untrustworthy conditions. Its staged training combines supervised learning and group-relative policy optimization.
authors: Zheng Wu; Heyuan Huang; Xingyu Lou; Xiangmou Qu; Pengzhou Cheng; Zongru Wu; Weiwen Liu; Weinan Zhang; Jun Wang; Zhaoxiang Wang; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: AgentSentinel: An End-to-End and Real-Time Security Defense Framework for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Introduces AgentSentinel, which intercepts sensitive computer-agent operations and audits them using task context together with system traces. BadComputerUse evaluates this enforcement approach across attack scenarios involving tool and computer control.
authors: Haitao Hu; Peng Chen; Yanpeng Zhao; Yuqi Chen

name: Dark Patterns Meet GUI Agents: LLM Agent Susceptibility to Manipulative Interfaces and the Role of Human Oversight
summary: Studies how GUI agents, people, and human-agent teams respond to manipulative interface designs. The two-phase evaluation examines failure modes and the benefits and costs of human oversight.
authors: Jingyu Tang; Chaoran Chen; Jiawen Li; Zhiping Zhang; Bingcan Guo; Ibrahim Khalilov; Simret Araya Gebreegziabher; Bingsheng Yao; Dakuo Wang; Yanfang Ye; Tianshi Li; Ziang Xiao; Yaxing Yao; Toby Jia-Jun Li

name: Agentic Lybic: Multi-Agent Execution System with Tiered Reasoning and Orchestration
summary: Introduces Agentic Lybic, a desktop automation system that routes tasks among GUI, code, and decision-support workers using a finite-state machine and evaluator.
authors: Liangxuan Guo; Bin Zhu; Qingqian Tao; Kangning Liu; Xun Zhao; Xianzhe Qin; Jin Gao; Guangfu Hao

name: Environmental Injection Attacks against GUI Agents in Realistic Dynamic Environments
summary: Introduces Chameleon, an environmental-injection evaluation framework that varies webpage content and trigger context. It combines simulated page variation with attention-based optimization and tests GUI agents across realistic websites.
authors: Yitong Zhang; Ximo Li; Liyi Cai; Jia Li

name: UI-S1: Advancing GUI Automation via Semi-online Reinforcement Learning
summary: UI-S1 simulates multi-turn online learning over offline trajectories, using a patch module to recover divergences while retaining the model’s own outputs in context. It combines discounted future returns with step- and episode-level advantages and introduces a semi-online performance proxy.
authors: Zhengxi Lu; Jiabo Ye; Fei Tang; Yongliang Shen; Haiyang Xu; Ziwei Zheng; Weiming Lu; Ming Yan; Fei Huang; Jun Xiao; Yueting Zhuang

name: How Auxiliary Reasoning Unleashes GUI Grounding in VLMs
summary: Studies the gap between latent visual grounding and explicit coordinate output in general vision-language models. Three zero-shot methods add axes, grids, or labeled intersections to GUI screenshots so models can express spatial locations without fine-tuning.
authors: Weiming Li; Yan Shao; Jing Yang; Yujing Lu; Ling Zhong; Yuhan Wang; Min Yu; Tongxiao Ruan; Manni Duan

name: PrivWeb: Unobtrusive and Content-aware Privacy Protection For Web Agents
summary: Introduces PrivWeb, which uses a local language model to anonymize interface information according to user preferences. Adaptive notifications and selective pauses give users control over sensitive information access during web-agent tasks.
authors: Shuning Zhang; Yutong Jiang; Rongjun Ma; Yuting Yang; Mingyao Xu; Zhixin Huang; Xin Yi; Hewu Li

name: ReSum: Unlocking Long-Horizon Search Intelligence via Context Summarization
summary: Introduces ReSum, which compresses interaction histories during long web searches, and ReSum-GRPO, which trains agents to reason across the resulting segments.
authors: Xixi Wu; Kuan Li; Yida Zhao; Liwen Zhang; Litu Ou; Huifeng Yin; Zhongwang Zhang; Xinmiao Yu; Dingchu Zhang; Yong Jiang; Pengjun Xie; Fei Huang; Minhao Cheng; Shuai Wang; Hong Cheng; Jingren Zhou

name: See, Think, Act: Teaching Multimodal Agents to Effectively Interact with GUI by Identifying Toggles
summary: Introduces a benchmark for binary GUI-toggle instructions and State-aware Reasoning, which compares the observed control state with the requested state before choosing an action. It evaluates agents on toggle tasks and broader interactive benchmarks.
authors: Zongru Wu; Rui Mao; Zhiyuan Tian; Pengzhou Cheng; Tianjie Ju; Zheng Wu; Lingzhong Dong; Haiyue Sheng; Zhuosheng Zhang; Gongshen Liu

name: InfraMind: A Novel Exploration-based GUI Agentic Framework for Mission-critical Industrial Management
summary: InfraMind explores industrial management GUIs using virtual-machine snapshots and builds memory for planning and hierarchical state recognition. Its framework also studies knowledge distillation and safety checks on open-source and commercial data-center management platforms.
authors: Liangtao Lin; Zhaomeng Zhu; Tianwei Zhang; Yonggang Wen

name: TGPO: Tree-Guided Preference Optimization for Robust Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: TGPO merges semantically equivalent web states into tree-structured trajectories for offline preference optimization. A process reward model scores subgoal progress, redundant behavior, and action validity, while dynamic weighting emphasizes consequential decisions.
authors: Ziyuan Chen; Zhenghui Zhao; Zhangye Han; Miancan Liu; Xianhang Ye; Yiqing Li; Hongbo Min; Jinkui Ren; Xiantao Zhang; Guitao Cao

name: Detecting Pipeline Failures through Fine-Grained Analysis of Web Agents
summary: Introduces a modular framework for identifying errors at intermediate stages of a web-agent pipeline. A SeeAct and Mind2Web case study examines weaknesses that are obscured by final task-success metrics.
authors: Daniel Röder; Akhil Juneja; Roland Roller; Sven Schmeier

name: ScaleCUA: Scaling Open-Source Computer Use Agents with Cross-Platform Data
summary: Introduces a cross-platform computer-use dataset and agents trained with a collection pipeline combining automated interaction and human input.
authors: Zhaoyang Liu; Jingjing Xie; Zichen Ding; Zehao Li; Bowen Yang; Zhenyu Wu; Xuehui Wang; Qiushi Sun; Shi Liu; Weiyun Wang; Shenglong Ye; Qingyun Li; Xuan Dong; Yue Yu; Chenyu Lu; YunXiang Mo; Yao Yan; Zeyue Tian; Xiao Zhang; Yuan Huang; Yiqian Liu; Weijie Su; Gen Luo; Xiangyu Yue; Biqing Qi; Kai Chen; Bowen Zhou; Yu Qiao; Qifeng Chen; Wenhai Wang

name: GUI-ARP: Enhancing Grounding with Adaptive Region Perception for GUI Agents
summary: GUI-ARP uses visual attention to crop relevant screenshot regions and decides whether a target needs single-stage or multi-stage analysis. Supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO trains this adaptive procedure for high-resolution GUI grounding.
authors: Xianhang Ye; Yiqing Li; Wei Dai; Miancan Liu; Ziyuan Chen; Zhangye Han; Hongbo Min; Jinkui Ren; Xiantao Zhang; Wen Yang; Zhi Jin

name: BTL-UI: Blink-Think-Link Reasoning Model for GUI Agent
summary: BTL-UI separates GUI interaction into screen-region attention, planning and executable-command generation. It adds an automated annotation pipeline and rule-based process/outcome rewards for training, with evaluation on both static understanding and dynamic interaction.
authors: Shaojie Zhang; Ruoceng Zhang; Pei Fu; Shaokang Wang; Jiahui Yang; Xin Du; Shiqi Cui; Bin Qin; Ying Huang; Zhenbo Luo; Jian Luan

name: GUI-ReWalk: Massive Data Generation for GUI Agent via Stochastic Exploration and Intent-Aware Reasoning
