authors: Guruprasad Viswanathan Ramesh; Asmit Nayak; Basieem Siddique; Kassem Fawaz

name: What's Missing in Screen-to-Action? Towards a UI-in-the-Loop Paradigm for Multimodal GUI Reasoning
summary: Introduces UILoop, which inserts explicit UI-element localization, function and usage reasoning between screen observation and action. UI Comprehension-Bench evaluates these element-level capabilities with three metrics.
authors: Songze Li; Xiaoke Guo; Tianqi Liu; Biao Yi; Zhaoyan Gong; Zhiqiang Liu; Huajun Chen; Wen Zhang

name: Android Coach: Improve Online Agentic Training Efficiency with Single State Multiple Actions
summary: Introduces Android Coach, which uses a learned critic to evaluate multiple candidate actions at each observed emulator state. Process rewards and a group-wise advantage estimator support online training, evaluated on AndroidLab and AndroidWorld.
authors: Guo Gan; Yuxuan Ding; Cong Chen; Yuwei Ren; Yin Huang; Hong Zhou

name: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents
summary: Introduces GameWorld, a browser-game benchmark that evaluates multimodal agents through keyboard and mouse controls or semantic actions using outcome checks.
authors: Mingyu Ouyang; Siyuan Hu; Kevin Qinghong Lin; Hwee Tou Ng; Mike Zheng Shou

name: Structured Distillation of Web Agent Capabilities Enables Generalization
summary: Introduces Agent-as-Annotators, which uses modular LLM roles to synthesize and filter web-agent trajectories for supervised training of a smaller web agent.
authors: Xing Han Lù; Siva Reddy

name: Are GUI Agents Focused Enough? Automated Distraction via Semantic-level UI Element Injection
summary: This study tests black-box GUI-grounding failures caused by strategically added, innocuous-looking UI elements. Its iterative overlay search is compared with random injection and repeated independent grounding trials to distinguish persistent misdirection from incidental clutter.
authors: Wenkui Yang; Chao Jin; Haisu Zhu; Weilin Luo; Derek Yuen; Kun Shao; Junxian Duan; Huaibo Huang; Jie Cao; Ran He

name: Same Outcomes, Different Journeys: A Trace-Level Framework for Comparing Human and GUI-Agent Behavior in Production Search Systems
summary: Presents a trace-level framework for comparing GUI agents with people on task outcomes, queries, and interface navigation in a production audio-search application.
authors: Maria Movin; Claudia Hauff; Aron Henriksson; Panagiotis Papapetrou

name: Preference Redirection via Attention Concentration: An Attack on Computer Use Agents
summary: Introduces PRAC, an adversarial-patch attack that redirects a computer-use agent's visual attention to steer product selection on an online shopping platform.
authors: Dominik Seip; Matthias Hein

name: KnowU-Bench: Towards Interactive, Proactive, and Personalized Mobile Agent Evaluation
summary: Introduces KnowU-Bench, an Android emulator benchmark for mobile agents that evaluates preference elicitation, proactive decisions, consent and GUI task execution.
authors: Tongbo Chen; Zhengxi Lu; Zhan Xu; Guocheng Shao; Shaohan Zhao; Fei Tang; Yong Du; Kaitao Song; Yizhou Liu; Yuchen Yan; Wenqi Zhang; Xu Tan; Weiming Lu; Jun Xiao; Yueting Zhuang; Yongliang Shen

name: MolmoWeb: Open Visual Web Agent and Open Data for the Open Web
summary: Presents MolmoWebMix, combining synthetic browser trajectories, human demonstrations and GUI perception data, and MolmoWeb screenshot-to-action policies trained from it. Browser benchmarks also test parallel rollouts with best-of-N selection.
authors: Tanmay Gupta; Piper Wolters; Zixian Ma; Peter Sushko; Rock Yuren Pang; Diego Llanes; Yue Yang; Taira Anderson; Boyuan Zheng; Zhongzheng Ren; Harsh Trivedi; Taylor Blanton; Caleb Ouellette; Winson Han; Ali Farhadi; Ranjay Krishna

name: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?
summary: Introduces ClawBench, 153 everyday tasks on production websites in 15 categories; an interception layer blocks each final submission so bookings, purchases and job applications are scored without side effects.

name: CORA: Conformal Risk-Controlled Agents for Safeguarded Mobile GUI Automation
summary: Introduces CORA, which calibrates a risk model to choose between executing and abstaining from mobile GUI actions, then diagnoses rejected actions to suggest interventions. Phone-Harm provides step-level safety labels for evaluating this safeguarding process.
authors: Yushi Feng; Junye Du; Qifan Wang; Zizhan Ma; Qian Niu; Yutaka Matsuo; Long Feng; Lequan Yu

name: Turing Test on Screen: A Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agent Humanization
summary: Introduces the Agent Humanization Benchmark (AHB) and mobile touch-dynamics data to assess whether GUI agents' interactions resemble human touch behavior.
authors: Jiachen Zhu; Lingyu Yang; Rong Shan; Congmin Zheng; Zeyu Zheng; Weiwen Liu; Yong Yu; Weinan Zhang; Jianghao Lin

name: Avenir-UX: Automated UX Evaluation via Simulated Human Web Interaction with GUI Grounding
summary: Avenir-UX combines grounded web interaction with simulated user profiles and structured usability measures to produce evaluations of website journeys. The paper describes its architecture and use of SUS, step-wise ease questions and think-aloud traces for automated UX reporting.
authors: Wee Joe Tan; Zi Rui Lucas Lim; Shashank Durgad; Karim Obegi; Aiden Yiliu Li

name: MobiFlow: Real-World Mobile Agent Benchmarking through Trajectory Fusion
summary: Introduces MobiFlow, a mobile-agent evaluation framework that fuses task trajectories into a state graph for dynamic interaction with third-party apps and measures task outcomes.
authors: Yunfei Feng; Xi Zhao; Cheng Zhang; Dahu Feng; Daolin Cheng; Jianqi Yu; Yubin Xia; Erhu Feng

name: Agentic Compilation: Mitigating the LLM Rerun Crisis for Minimized-Inference-Cost Web Automation
summary: Proposes Compile-and-Execute, which turns a sanitized DOM into a reusable JSON workflow so repetitive browser tasks can run without further model queries.
authors: Jagadeesh Chundru

name: EE-MCP: Self-Evolving MCP-GUI Agents via Automated Environment Generation and Experience Learning
summary: EE-MCP studies application-dependent mixtures of GUI actions and MCP calls using generated environments, trajectory collection and filtered training. An experience bank extracts rules from trajectory comparisons for inference-time improvement, distinct from model distillation.
authors: Tiantian He; Yihang Chen; Keyue Jiang; Ka Yiu Lee; Kaiwen Zhou; Kun Shao; Shuai Wang

name: HealthAdminBench: Evaluating Computer-Use Agents on Healthcare Administration Tasks
summary: Introduces HealthAdminBench with GUI environments for an electronic health record, payer portals and fax handling. Expert-defined administrative tasks are decomposed into verifiable subtasks to compare local progress with end-to-end workflow completion.
authors: Suhana Bedi; Ryan Welch; Ethan Steinberg; Michael Wornow; Taeil Matthew Kim; Haroun Ahmed; Peter Sterling; Bravim Purohit; Qurat Akram; Angelic Acosta; Esther Nubla; Pritika Sharma; Michael A. Pfeffer; Sanmi Koyejo; Nigam H. Shah

name: The Blind Spot of Agent Safety: How Benign User Instructions Expose Critical Vulnerabilities in Computer-Use Agents
summary: Introduces OS-BLIND, a computer-use agent safety benchmark for harmful outcomes arising from benign instructions and threats in task environments.
authors: Xuwei Ding; Skylar Zhai; Linxin Song; Jiate Li; Taiwei Shi; Nicholas Meade; Siva Reddy; Jian Kang; Jieyu Zhao

name: WebForge: Breaking the Realism-Reproducibility-Scalability Trilemma in Browser Agent Benchmark
summary: Presents WebForge, a pipeline that plans, generates, refines and validates self-contained interactive websites. WebForge-Bench uses these environments to evaluate browser agents across domains and controlled difficulty levels.
authors: Peng Yuan; Yuyang Yin; Yuxuan Cai; Zheng Wei

name: CocoaBench: Evaluating Unified Digital Agents in the Wild
summary: Introduces CocoaBench, a benchmark for unified digital agents on long-horizon tasks combining vision, search, and coding, including capabilities related to GUI automation.
authors: CocoaBench Team; Shibo Hao; Zhining Zhang; Zhiqi Liang; Tianyang Liu; Yuheng Zha; Qiyue Gao; Jixuan Chen; Zilong Wang; Zhoujun Cheng; Haoxiang Zhang; Junli Wang; Hexi Jin; Boyuan Zheng; Kun Zhou; Yu Wang; Feng Yao; Licheng Liu; Yijiang Li; Zhifei Li; Zhengtao Han; Pracha Promthaw; Tommaso Cerruti; Xiaohan Fu; Ziqiao Ma; Jingbo Shang; Lianhui Qin; Julian McAuley; Eric P. Xing; Zhengzhong Liu; Rupesh Kumar Srivastava; Zhiting Hu

name: Mobile GUI Agent Privacy Personalization with Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization
summary: Proposes Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization (TIPO) to train mobile GUI agents for differing user privacy preferences across structurally different task trajectories.
authors: Zhixin Lin; Jungang Li; Dongliang Xu; Shidong Pan; Yibo Shi; Yuchi Liu; Yuecong Min; Yue Yao

name: ClawGUI: A Unified Framework for Training, Evaluating, and Deploying GUI Agents
summary: Presents ClawGUI, a shared harness for GUI-agent reinforcement learning, benchmark evaluation and deployment on mobile devices. It combines parallel virtual and physical environments, process rewards, and hybrid CLI-GUI execution with persistent memory.
authors: Fei Tang; Zhiqiong Lu; Boxuan Zhang; Weiming Lu; Jun Xiao; Yueting Zhuang; Yongliang Shen

name: WebAgentGuard: A Reasoning-Driven Guard Model for Detecting Prompt Injection Attacks in Web Agents
summary: WebAgentGuard separates prompt-injection detection from the operating web agent through a parallel multimodal guard. The guard is trained on synthetic visual/textual examples using reasoning-focused supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning.
authors: Yulin Chen; Tri Cao; Haoran Li; Yue Liu; Yibo Li; Yufei He; Le Minh Khoi; Yangqiu Song; Shuicheng Yan; Bryan Hooi

name: From Imitation to Discrimination: Progressive Curriculum Learning for Robust Web Navigation
summary: Introduces the Triton dataset and a staged training curriculum for text-based web navigation agents, using hard-negative HTML examples to train element discrimination and longer task execution.
authors: Chuang Peng; Wei Zhang; Renshuai Tao; Xinhao Zhang; Jian Yang

name: PrecisionCUA: Iterative Visual Refinement for Pixel-Precise Cursor Grounding in Code Editors
summary: Studies iterative cursor grounding in dense code-editor interfaces, using visual feedback from earlier attempts to correct displacement. PrecisionCUA evaluates this closed-loop process across multiple model families on coding-interface tasks.
authors: Himangi Mittal; Gaurav Mittal; Nelson Daniel Troncoso; Yu Hu

name: WebXSkill: Skill Learning for Autonomous Web Agents
summary: WebXSkill pairs parameterized action programs with step-level language guidance, mining reusable skills from synthetic browser-agent traces. A URL-based graph supports retrieval, and deployment alternates between direct program execution and guided native planning.
authors: Zhaoyang Wang; Qianhui Wu; Xuchao Zhang; Chaoyun Zhang; Wenlin Yao; Fazle Elahi Faisal; Baolin Peng; Si Qin; Suman Nath; Qingwei Lin; Chetan Bansal; Dongmei Zhang; Saravan Rajmohan; Jianfeng Gao; Huaxiu Yao

name: Towards Scalable Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-role Orchestration
summary: Introduces LAMO, a training framework for a lightweight GUI agent that can execute tasks alone or serve as an action executor alongside planners in multi-agent workflows.
authors: Ziwei Wang; Junjie Zheng; Leyang Yang; Sheng Zhou; Xiaoxuan Tang; Zhouhua Fang; Zhiwei Liu; Dajun Chen; Yong Li; Jiajun Bu

name: RiskWebWorld: A Realistic Interactive Benchmark for GUI Agents in E-commerce Risk Management
summary: Introduces RiskWebWorld, an interactive benchmark of e-commerce risk-management tasks for GUI agents on websites, with Gymnasium infrastructure for evaluation and agentic RL.
authors: Renqi Chen; Zeyin Tao; Jianming Guo; Jing Wang; Zezhou Xu; Jingzhe Zhu; Qingqing Sun; Tianyi Zhang; Shuai Chen

name: UI-Copilot: Advancing Long-Horizon GUI Automation via Tool-Integrated Policy Optimization
summary: UI-Copilot separates GUI execution from on-demand memory retrieval and numerical assistance. Its training procedure treats tool selection and multi-turn task execution as distinct optimization targets while keeping persistent observations outside transient context.
authors: Zhengxi Lu; Fei Tang; Guangyi Liu; Kaitao Song; Xu Tan; Jin Ma; Wenqi Zhang; Weiming Lu; Jun Xiao; Yueting Zhuang; Yongliang Shen

name: UI-Zoomer: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Zoom-In for GUI Grounding
summary: Introduces UI-Zoomer, a training-free grounding method that uses candidate agreement and token confidence to decide when to crop and retry. Prediction variance determines a separate crop radius for each uncertain interface target.
authors: Fei Tang; Bofan Chen; Zhengxi Lu; Tongbo Chen; Songqin Nong; Tao Jiang; Wenhao Xu; Weiming Lu; Jun Xiao; Yueting Zhuang; Yongliang Shen

name: GUI-Perturbed: Domain Randomization Reveals Systematic Brittleness in GUI Grounding Models
summary: Introduces GUI-Perturbed, which varies screenshot appearance and instruction wording independently to diagnose grounding failures. Experiments on three related model architectures examine relational instructions, browser zoom and augmentation-based fine-tuning.
authors: Yangyue Wang; Harshvardhan Sikka; Yash Mathur; Tony Zhou; Jinu Nyachhyon; Pranav Guruprasad

name: Beyond Chat and Clicks: GUI Agents for In-Situ Assistance via Live Interface Transformation
summary: DOMSteer translates help requests and live page context into reversible DOM changes such as control highlighting, contextual tooltips and layout reorganization. The work evaluates in-place GUI assistance with interface tests, use cases and a comparative user study.
authors: Pan Hao; Rishi Selvakumaran; Jacob Sun; Qianwen Wang

name: SkillDroid: Compile Once, Reuse Forever
summary: Introduces SkillDroid, which compiles successful mobile GUI trajectories into reusable action templates and replays them without model calls, recompiling when they degrade.
authors: Qijia Chen; Andrea Bellucci; Zhida Sun; Giulio Jacucci

name: FedGUI: Benchmarking Federated GUI Agents across Heterogeneous Platforms, Devices, and Operating Systems
summary: Introduces FedGUI, a federated GUI-learning benchmark built from six datasets spanning mobile, web and desktop interfaces. Its experiments separate platform, device, operating-system and data-source heterogeneity when evaluating collaborative training.
authors: Wenhao Wang; Haoting Shi; Mengying Yuan; Yiquan Lin; Panrong Tong; Hanzhang Zhou; Guangyi Liu; Pengxiang Zhao; Yue Wang; Siheng Chen

name: OpenMobile: Building Open Mobile Agents with Task and Trajectory Synthesis
summary: Presents OpenMobile, which builds exploration-based environment memory to synthesize task instructions and switches between learner and expert policies during trajectory collection. The resulting data includes recovery behavior and is tested through mobile-agent training and benchmark-overlap analysis.
authors: Kanzhi Cheng; Zehao Li; Zheng Ma; Nuo Chen; Jialin Cao; Qiushi Sun; Zichen Ding; Fangzhi Xu; Hang Yan; Jiajun Chen; Anh Tuan Luu; Jianbing Zhang; Lewei Lu; Dahua Lin

name: Zoom Consistency: A Free Confidence Signal in Multi-Step Visual Grounding Pipelines
summary: Proposes zoom consistency as a confidence signal for multistep GUI grounding and uses it to route between specialist and generalist visual grounding models.
authors: Keon Kim; Krish Chelikavada

name: StressWeb: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Web Agent Robustness under Realistic Interaction Variability
summary: Introduces a web-agent stress-testing benchmark with controlled changes to layouts, interaction semantics, and execution for diagnosing behavior under varied conditions.
authors: Haoyue Bai; Dong Wang; Long Chen; Bingguang Hao; Pengyang Shao; Yonghui Yang; Yicheng He; Chenyi Zhuang

name: Penny Wise, Pixel Foolish: Bypassing Price Constraints in Multimodal Agents via Visual Adversarial Perturbations
summary: Introduces PriceBlind, a visual perturbation method for controlled screenshot-based evaluation of price-constrained multimodal agents. The reported transfer experiments use a simplified single-turn coordinate-selection protocol.
authors: Jiachen Qian; Zhaolu Kang

name: AgentClick: A Skill-Based Human-in-the-Loop Review Layer for Terminal AI Agents
summary: AgentClick gives terminal-based agents a browser review interface for plans, drafts, execution traces and editable memory. A local server and skill plugin let users inspect proposed actions and provide structured feedback.
authors: Haomin Zhuang; Hanwen Xing; Xiangliang Zhang

name: A Survey on Long-Term Memory Security in LLM Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Governance Across the Memory Lifecycle
summary: Organizes security risks and defenses for persistent agent memory into six lifecycle phases and proposes five verifiable governance primitives.
authors: Zehao Lin; Xixuan Hao; Renyu Fu; Shaobo Cui; Kai Chen; Chunyu Li; Zhiyu Li; Feiyu Xiong

name: HalluClear: Diagnosing, Evaluating and Mitigating Hallucinations in GUI Agents
summary: Introduces HalluClear with a GUI hallucination taxonomy, expert-calibrated evaluation workflow and structured-reasoning post-training scheme. It evaluates how these components affect hallucinations, grounding and action fidelity across GUI agents.
authors: Chao Jin; Wenkui Yang; Hao Sun; Yuqi Liao; Qianyi Jiang; Kai Zhou; Jie Cao; Ran He; Huaibo Huang

name: Do LLMs Need to See Everything? A Benchmark and Study of Failures in LLM-driven Smartphone Automation using Screentext vs. Screenshots
summary: DailyDroid compares text-only and text-plus-screenshot agents on everyday Android tasks across multiple apps and difficulty levels. Its failure analysis examines accessibility, observation modality and agent/application behavior.
authors: Shiquan Zhang; Tianyi Zhang; Le Fang; Simon D'Alfonso; Hong Jia; Vassilis Kostakos

name: WebUncertainty: Dual-Level Uncertainty Driven Planning and Reasoning For Autonomous Web Agent
summary: WebUncertainty adapts planning mode to task uncertainty and guides action-level tree search with confidence-derived uncertainty estimates. Its evaluations examine autonomous execution of dynamic, long-horizon web tasks on WebArena and WebVoyager.
authors: Lingfeng Zhang; Yongan Sun; Jinpeng Hu; Hui Ma; Yang Ying; Kuien Liu; Zenglin Shi; Meng Wang

name: On the Reliability of Computer Use Agents
summary: This study examines repeated OSWorld executions to separate execution stochasticity, task-specification ambiguity and behavioral variation. Paired task-level tests show why one successful run is insufficient evidence of reliable computer use.
authors: Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega; Saaket Agashe; Jiachen Yang; Ang Li; Xin Eric Wang

name: AJ-Bench: Benchmarking Agent-as-a-Judge for Environment-Aware Evaluation
summary: AJ-Bench evaluates judge agents that actively gather evidence from search, data systems and graphical interfaces. Its annotated tasks and trajectories test information acquisition, state verification and process verification.
authors: Wentao Shi; Yu Wang; Yuyang Zhao; Yuxin Chen; Fuli Feng; Xueyuan Hao; Xi Su; Qi Gu; Hui Su; Xunliang Cai; Xiangnan He

name: Mango: Multi-Agent Web Navigation via Global-View Optimization
summary: Proposes Mango, a multi-agent web-navigation method that selects starting URLs using Thompson Sampling and stores navigation history to inform later attempts.
authors: Weixi Tong; Yifeng Di; Tianyi Zhang

name: Human-Guided Harm Recovery for Computer Use Agents
summary: Introduces a preference-trained reward model for guiding computer-use agents out of harmful states and BackBench, a benchmark of recovery tasks.
authors: Christy Li; Sky CH-Wang; Andi Peng; Andreea Bobu

name: Temporal UI State Inconsistency in Desktop GUI Agents: Formalizing and Defending Against TOCTOU Attacks on Computer-Use Agents
summary: This study examines UI changes between a desktop agent’s screenshot observation and action dispatch. Its pre-execution state checks address overlay and focus manipulation, while the reported DOM-injection blind spot limits the defense’s coverage.
authors: Wenpeng Xu

name: AutomationBench
summary: Introduces AutomationBench, a benchmark for agents coordinating business workflows across applications through REST APIs, including endpoint discovery and policy adherence.
authors: Daniel Shepard; Robin Salimans

name: PlayCoder: Making LLM-Generated GUI Code Playable
summary: PlayEval measures whether generated GUI applications remain logically playable, using PlayTester to execute task-oriented GUI playthroughs. PlayCoder closes the loop between repository-aware generation, interactive testing and targeted code repair.
authors: Zhiyuan Peng; Wei Tao; Xin Yin; Chenhao Ying; Yuan Luo; Yiwen Guo

name: AgentLens: Adaptive Visual Modalities for Human-Agent Interaction in Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Introduces AgentLens, a mobile GUI agent that shows full, partial, or generated interface views during background task execution to support user interaction.
authors: Jeonghyeon Kim; Byeongjun Joung; Junwon Lee; Joohyung Lee; Taehoon Min; Sunjae Lee

name: Measure Twice, Click Once: Co-evolving Proposer and Visual Critic via Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding
summary: Trains a GUI grounding proposer together with a visual critic that evaluates candidate locations rendered on screenshots. An adaptive reinforcement-learning schedule balances their development, using proposal diversity and critic feedback during training.
authors: Wenkai Wang; Xiyun Li; Hongcan Guo; Wenhao Yu; Tianqing Fang; Haitao Mi; Dong Yu; Shengyu Zhang

name: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
summary: VLAA-GUI combines mandatory checks for visually supported completion, multi-tier loop recovery and on-demand workflow search. Optional coding and grounding agents support execution, with component ablations on Linux and Windows GUI tasks.
authors: Qijun Han; Haoqin Tu; Zijun Wang; Haoyue Dai; Yiyang Zhou; Nancy Lau; Alvaro A. Cardenas; Yuhui Xu; Ran Xu; Caiming Xiong; Zeyu Zheng; Huaxiu Yao; Yuyin Zhou; Cihang Xie

name: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning
summary: SOLAR-RL trains GUI navigation agents by reconstructing rollout candidates from static data and assigning step rewards that reflect trajectory quality.
authors: Jichao Wang; Liuyang Bian; Yufeng Zhou; Han Xiao; Yue Pan; Guozhi Wang; Hao Wang; Zhaoxiong Wang; Yafei Wen; Xiaoxin Chen; Shuai Ren; Lingfang Zeng

name: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
summary: Survey of agentic world models that classifies predictive capabilities and governing laws, including the digital setting of web and GUI agents.
authors: Meng Chu; Xuan Billy Zhang; Kevin Qinghong Lin; Lingdong Kong; Jize Zhang; Teng Tu; Weijian Ma; Ziqi Huang; Senqiao Yang; Wei Huang; Yeying Jin; Zhefan Rao; Jinhui Ye; Xinyu Lin; Xichen Zhang; Qisheng Hu; Shuai Yang; Leyang Shen; Wei Chow; Yifei Dong; Fengyi Wu; Quanyu Long; Bin Xia; Shaozuo Yu; Mingkang Zhu; Wenhu Zhang; Jiehui Huang; Haokun Gui; Runyi Li; Chenyu Tang; Dong Huang; Xuhang Chen; Rui Liu; Chengzu Li; Shiyi Du; Xu Huang; Haoxuan Che; Long Chen; Qifeng Chen; Wenya Wang; Wenxuan Zhang; Xiaojuan Qi; Yang Deng; Yanwei Li; Mike Zheng Shou; Zhi-Qi Cheng; See-Kiong Ng; Ziwei Liu; Philip Torr; Jiaya Jia

name: PageGuide: Browser extension to assist users in navigating a webpage and locating information
summary: PageGuide is a browser extension that highlights evidence for answers on a page and guides users through web pages with evidence captured at each step.
authors: Tin Nguyen; Thang T. Truong; Runtao Zhou; Trung Bui; Chirag Agarwal; Anh Totti Nguyen

name: GoClick: Lightweight Element Grounding Model for Autonomous GUI Interaction
summary: Studies a compact encoder-decoder grounding model and progressive training-data refinement for resource-constrained GUI interaction.
authors: Hongxin Li; Yuntao Chen; Zhaoxiang Zhang

name: OS-SPEAR: A Toolkit for the Safety, Performance,Efficiency, and Robustness Analysis of OS Agents
summary: Provides an evaluation toolkit for joint safety, efficiency, and multimodal robustness analysis of operating-system GUI agents.
authors: Zheng Wu; Yi Hua; Zhaoyuan Huang; Chenhao Xue; Yijie Lu; Pengzhou Cheng; Zongru Wu; Lingzhong Dong; Gongshen Liu; Xinghao Jiang; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark
summary: AutoGUI-v2 evaluates interface functionality, grounding and predicted interaction outcomes using hierarchical regions derived through VLM-human annotation. Its tasks span multiple operating systems and expose differences between functional localization, captioning and transition-logic understanding.
authors: Hongxin Li; Xiping Wang; Jingran Su; Zheng Ju; Yuntao Chen; Qing Li; Zhaoxiang Zhang

name: Odysseys: Benchmarking Web Agents on Realistic Long Horizon Tasks
summary: Introduces Odysseys, a live-web benchmark of long, multi-site tasks derived from browsing sessions. Graded task rubrics and a rubric-score-per-step measure evaluate both partial progress and trajectory efficiency.
authors: Lawrence Keunho Jang; Jing Yu Koh; Daniel Fried; Ruslan Salakhutdinov

name: Benchmarking and Improving GUI Agents in High-Dynamic Environments
summary: Introduces DynamicGUIBench for applications whose interfaces change between actions, together with DynamicUI, an agent that processes screen recordings. The agent selects informative frames, filters inconsistent action reasoning and uses trajectory reflection for subsequent decisions.
authors: Enqi Liu; Liyuan Pan; Zhi Gao; Yan Yang; Chenrui Shi; Yang Liu; Jingrong Wu; Qing Li

name: SnapGuard: Lightweight Prompt Injection Detection for Screenshot-Based Web Agents
summary: SnapGuard detects screenshot-based prompt injection through complementary visual-stability and recovered textual cues. Its evaluation compares detection quality and inference cost across attack and benign-page settings.
authors: Mengyao Du; Han Fang; Haokai Ma; Jiahao Chen; Kai Xu; Quanjun Yin; Ee-Chien Chang

name: Training Computer Use Agents to Assess the Usability of Graphical User Interfaces
summary: uxCUA learns to assess interface usability by choosing interaction flows, executing them and predicting a numerical usability score. Training uses interactive UIs with usability labels and human preferences, with evaluations on synthetic and real interfaces.
authors: Alice Gao; Weixi Tong; Rishab Vempati; Katharina Reinecke; R. Benjamin Shapiro; Tianyi Zhang; Jason Wu

name: Beyond Screenshots: Evaluating VLMs' Understanding of UI Animations
summary: AniMINT evaluates how VLMs perceive, explain and interpret UI animations using densely annotated videos. The study distinguishes basic motion recognition from higher-level animation meaning and probes motion, context and perceptual cues.
authors: Chen Liang; Xirui Jiang; Naihao Deng; Eytan Adar; Anhong Guo

name: Step-level Optimization for Efficient Computer-use Agents
summary: Proposes a step-level model cascade that runs a smaller computer-use policy until learned monitors flag stalled progress or semantic drift. Separate history-based stuck detection and milestone checks determine when to escalate for recovery or verification without retraining the larger model.
authors: Jinbiao Wei; Kangqi Ni; Yilun Zhao; Guo Gan; Arman Cohan

name: AutoSurfer -- Teaching Web Agents through Comprehensive Surfing, Learning, and Modeling
summary: AutoSurfer explores website actions breadth-first, retaining page and trajectory knowledge to guide task synthesis and trajectory refinement. It evaluates the resulting training data by fine-tuning a web agent on WebArena and examining synthesized-task diversity.
authors: Fazle Elahi Faisal; Qianhui Wu; Baolin Peng; Jianfeng Gao

name: WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
summary: Introduces WindowsWorld for professional workflows spanning multiple desktop applications, with generated tasks refined through human review. Intermediate subgoals support process-oriented evaluation of cross-application reasoning and execution efficiency.
authors: Jinchao Li; Yunxin Li; Chenrui Zhao; Zhenran Xu; Baotian Hu; Min Zhang

name: FineState-Bench: Benchmarking State-Conditioned Grounding for Fine-grained GUI State Setting
summary: FineState-Bench tests whether GUI agents locate the intended control and set its exact state across desktop, web, and mobile interfaces, with stage-wise diagnostic metrics.
authors: Fengxian Ji; Jingpu Yang; Zirui Song; Yuanxi Wang; Zhexuan Cui; Yuke Li; Qian Jiang; Xiuying Chen

name: Exploring LLM Agent Designs and Interaction Modalities for Scientific Visualization
summary: This study compares specialized, computer-use and coding agents on scientific visualization workflows. It examines GUI, CLI, code and tool-call interaction modes, including how persistent memory changes performance across repeated trials.
authors: Jackson Vonderhorst; Kuangshi Ai; Haichao Miao; Shusen Liu; Chaoli Wang

name: A11y-Compressor: A Framework for Enhancing the Efficiency of GUI Agent Observations through Visual Context Reconstruction and Redundancy Reduction
summary: A11y-Compressor transforms linearized accessibility trees through modal detection, redundancy reduction and semantic structuring. Its OSWorld evaluation measures both observation-token reduction and task success.
authors: Michito Takeshita; Takuro Kawada; Takumi Ohashi; Shunsuke Kitada; Hitoshi Iyatomi

name: Learn where to Click from Yourself: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
summary: Introduces GUI-SD, an on-policy self-distillation method for locating GUI elements from instructions, using a visually enriched teacher context and entropy-guided token weighting.
authors: Yan Zhang; Daiqing Wu; Huawen Shen; Can Ma; Yu Zhou

name: Faithful Mobile GUI Agents with Guided Advantage Estimator
summary: Introduces Faithful-Agent, which first teaches abstention under perturbed evidence and then refines GUI policies with an anchor-based, variance-adaptive advantage estimator. A thought-action consistency reward encourages decisions grounded in displayed evidence and instructions.
authors: Haowen Hu; Pengzhou Cheng; Zheng Wu; Lingzhong Dong; Gongshen Liu; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: Planner Matters! An Efficient and Unbalanced Multi-agent Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Planning
summary: A planner-centric RL framework divides agent automation among a planner, actor, and memory manager, with evaluations that include web navigation and OS control.
authors: Wenyi Wu; Sibo Zhu; Kun Zhou; Biwei Huang

name: AutoFocus: Uncertainty-Aware Active Visual Search for GUI Grounding
summary: Presents AutoFocus, a training-free grounding method that turns sampled coordinates and token uncertainty into spatial region proposals. Shape-aware crops and visual comparison select a target while retaining surrounding interface context.
authors: Ruilin Yao; Shegnwu Xiong; Tianyu Zou; Shili Xiong; Yi Rong

name: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents
summary: AcademiClaw benchmarks OpenClaw agents on long academic workflows, scoring task completion in isolated Docker sandboxes with rubrics and a safety audit.
authors: Junjie Yu; Pengrui Lu; Weiye Si; Hongliang Lu; Jiabao Wu; Kaiwen Tao; Kun Wang; Lingyu Yang; Qiran Zhang; Xiuting Guo; Xuanyu Wang; Yang Wang; Yanjie Wang; Yi Yang; Zijian Hu; Ziyi Yang; Zonghan Zhou; Binghao Qiang; Borui Zhang; Chenning Li; Enchang Zhang; Feifan Chen; Feng Jian; Fengyin Sun; Hao Qiu; Hao Zheng; Haoran Zhu; Hongyu Liu; Jianbin Deng; Jiaxin Song; Jiaying Chi; Jiayou Shi; Jie Fang; Jinghui Zhong; Jingyu Zhou; Jinze Li; Junfeng Yi; Junyan Yu; Junzhi Xue; Ni Song; Pengyi Chen; Qi Chen; Quansheng Li; Rui Tao; Shenghai Gong; Shenhang Lu; Tianqi Shen; Tianxiang Zhu; Tiehan Kang; Tingyu Li; Wendi Wu; Xiao Shen; Xiao Zhou; Xiaotao Zhang; Xinrong Li; Xuankun Yang; Xun Zhang; Yan Li; Ye Lu; Yi Wang; Yibo Zhou; Yichi Zhang; Yihao Sun; Yijun Huang; Yixin Zhu; Yixuan Wu; Yuchen Sun; Yue Wu; Yuheng Sun; Yukun Li; Yutian Tu; Yuxuan Qin; Yuzhuo Wu; Zeyu Li; Zhengyu Lou; Zhenning Ran; Zizhu He; Pengfei Liu

name: Augmenting Interface Usability Heuristics for Reliable Computer-Use Agents
summary: A study adapts interface usability heuristics for computer-use agents and evaluates augmented designs in UI-Verse, a suite of controlled interface environments.
authors: Jiateng Liu; Rushi Wang; Bingxuan Li; Kunlun Zhu; Yifan Shen; Qingyun Wang; Ahmed Abbasi; Denghui Zhang; Heng Ji

name: cotomi Act: Learning to Automate Work by Watching You
summary: cotomi Act is a browser agent that executes multi-step tasks and turns observed user browsing into persistent knowledge shared with users.
authors: Masafumi Oyamada; Kunihiro Takeoka; Kosuke Akimoto; Ryoma Obara; Masafumi Enomoto; Haochen Zhang; Daichi Haraguchi; Takuya Tamura

name: WAAA! Web Adversaries Against Agentic Browsers
summary: Evaluates agentic browsers against classical web attacks and visual social-engineering lures beyond indirect prompt injection.
authors: Sohom Datta; Alex Nahapetyan; William Enck; Alexandros Kapravelos

name: X-OmniClaw Technical Report: A Unified Mobile Agent for Multimodal Understanding and Interaction
summary: Describes an Android agent architecture combining multimodal perception, working and personal memory, hybrid XML/visual grounding, and reusable skills captured from user interactions.
authors: Xiaoming Ren; Ru Zhen; Chao Li; Yang Song; Qiuxia Hou; Yanhao Zhang; Peng Liu; Qi Qi; Quanlong Zheng; Qi Wu; Zhenyi Liao; Binqiang Pan; Haobo Ji; Haonan Lu

name: Constraining Host-Level Abuse in Self-Hosted Computer-Use Agents via TEE-Backed Isolation
summary: A TEE-backed design confines host operations by self-hosted computer-use agents, classifying and authorizing actions before constrained local execution.
authors: Di Lu; Bo Zhang; Xiyuan Li; Yongzhi Liao; Xuewen Dong; Yulong Shen; Zhiquan Liu; Jianfeng Ma

name: BAMI: Training-Free Bias Mitigation in GUI Grounding
summary: BAMI uses coarse-to-fine focus and candidate selection at inference time to address precision and ambiguity errors in GUI grounding.
authors: Borui Zhang; Bo Zhang; Bo Wang; Wenzhao Zheng; Yuhao Cheng; Liang Tang; Yiqiang Yan; Jie Zhou; Jiwen Lu

name: Weblica: Scalable and Reproducible Training Environments for Visual Web Agents
summary: Introduces Weblica, which combines HTTP-level capture and replay with website-grounded environment synthesis. The resulting interactive web environments support reinforcement learning and tests of navigation transfer and inference-time scaling.
authors: Oğuzhan Fatih Kar; Roman Bachmann; Yuanzheng Gong; Anders Boesen Lindbo Larsen; Afshin Dehghan

name: Securing Computer-Use Agents: A Unified Architecture-Lifecycle Framework for Deployment-Grounded Reliability
summary: Survey of computer-use agent reliability and security across browsers, desktops, and mobile apps, using architecture and lifecycle views to map failures and controls.
authors: Zejian Chen; Zhanyuan Liu; Chaozhuo Li; Mengxiang Han; Songyang Liu; Litian Zhang; Feng Gao; Yiming Hei; Xi Zhang

name: Region4Web: Rethinking Observation Space Granularity for Web Agents
summary: Reorganizes webpage accessibility trees into functional regions through hierarchical decomposition and semantic abstraction. PageDigest supplies a persistent region-level observation to web agents, evaluated on WebArena.
authors: Donguk Kwon; Dongha Lee

name: LiteGUI: Lightweight GUI Agents via Multi-Solution Guided Distillation and Dual-Level Reinforcement Learning
summary: LiteGUI trains lightweight GUI agents on logged states with guided on-policy distillation and dual-level RL, supported by its multi-solution Lite-Dataset.
authors: Yubin Wu; Zicheng Cai; Liping Ning; Hua Wang; Zhi Chen; Yaohua Tang; Hao Chen

name: Computer Use at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
summary: DigiWorld is a sandboxed mobile-app benchmark for computer-use agents, paired with PRISM environment principles and a confidence-interval aggregation method.
authors: Pierluca D'Oro; Sneha Silwal; William Wong; Yuxuan Sun; Fanyi Xiao; Manchen Wang; Eric Gan; Allen Bolourchi; Joseph Tighe

name: WebTrap: Stealthy Mid-Task Hijacking of Browser Agents During Navigation
summary: WebTrap injects mid-task instructions into browser-agent navigation to steer an agent toward an attacker goal before it resumes the user's task.
authors: Zhichao Liu; Wenbo Pan; Haining Yu; Ge Gao; Tianqing Zhu; Xiaohua Jia

name: OTora: A Unified Red Teaming Framework for Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service in LLM Agents
summary: OTora generates attacks that increase reasoning and tool use in multi-step LLM agents while preserving task outcomes; evaluations include WebShop agents.
authors: Xinyu Li; Ronghui Mu; Lin Li; Tianjin Huang; Gaojie Jin

name: Mem-W: Latent Memory-Native GUI Agents
summary: Introduces Mem-W, which compresses previous trajectories and current-session segments into latent memory tokens used directly by the GUI policy. Self-distillation and outcome supervision train this memory representation for web and mobile navigation.
authors: Guibin Zhang; Yaohui Ling; Fanci Meng; Kun Wang; Shuicheng Yan

name: Don't Click That: Teaching Web Agents to Resist Deceptive Interfaces
summary: DUDE combines asymmetric hybrid-reward learning with summaries of deceptive-interface failures to guide safer web actions. Its RUC benchmark evaluates deception susceptibility alongside ordinary task performance across interface scenarios.
authors: Yilin Zhang; Yingkai Hua; Chunyu Wei; Xin Wang; Yueguo Chen

name: How Mobile World Model Guides GUI Agents?
summary: Compares mobile world models that predict state changes as delta text, full text, images or renderable code. Downstream Android benchmarks examine synthetic training trajectories and test-time guidance, including limits of post-action reflection.
authors: Weikai Xu; Kun Huang; Yunren Feng; Jiaxing Li; Yuhan Chen; Yuxuan Liu; Zhizheng Jiang; Heng Qu; Pengzhi Gao; Wei Liu; Jian Luan; Xiaolin Hu; Bo An

name: WildClawBench: A Benchmark for Real-World, Long-Horizon Agent Evaluation
summary: WildClawBench evaluates CLI agents on long, multimodal tasks in Docker containers with real tools, using task checks, side-effect audits, and a semantic judge.
authors: Shuangrui Ding; Xuanlang Dai; Long Xing; Shengyuan Ding; Ziyu Liu; Yang JingYi; Penghui Yang; Zhixiong Zhang; Xilin Wei; Xinyu Fang; Yubo Ma; Haodong Duan; Jing Shao; Jiaqi Wang; Dahua Lin; Kai Chen; Yuhang Zang

name: MMTB: Evaluating Terminal Agents on Multimedia-File Tasks
summary: MultiMedia-TerminalBench evaluates agents that use terminal tools to work with audio and video files. The Terminus-MM harness adds multimedia perception to study how accessible evidence changes executable workflows and task outcomes.
authors: Chiyeong Heo; Jaechang Kim; Junhyuk Kwon; Hoyoung Kim; Dongmin Park; Jonghyun Lee; Jungseul Ok

name: ReVision: Scaling Computer-Use Agents via Temporal Visual Redundancy Reduction
summary: Trains GUI agents with a learned selector that removes repeated visual patches across consecutive screenshots while preserving spatial structure. ReVision evaluates this history representation on OSWorld, WebTailBench and AgentNetBench.
authors: Amirhossein Abaskohi; Yuhang He; Peter West; Giuseppe Carenini; Pranit Chawla; Vibhav Vineet

name: Executable Agentic Memory for GUI Agent
summary: Executable Agentic Memory stores GUI routines in a knowledge graph built through state-aware exploration and action-group mining. A learned value model guides tree search over this executable memory for retrieval-based planning, with AndroidWorld and efficiency evaluation.
authors: Zerui Qin; Sheng Yue; Xingyuan Hua; Yongjian Fu; Ju Ren

name: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents
summary: ToolCUA synthesizes interleaved GUI/tool trajectories and trains agents to choose between graphical actions and higher-level tools. Staged supervised and reinforcement learning culminate in online hybrid-environment training with a reward for efficient execution paths.
authors: Xuhao Hu; Xi Zhang; Haiyang Xu; Kyle Qiao; Jingyi Yang; Xuanjing Huang; Jing Shao; Ming Yan; Jieping Ye
topics: tool-integration; data-generation; imitation-learning; reinforcement-learning; planning; efficiency

name: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
summary: LongMemEval-V2 asks memory systems to recover environment knowledge from long web-agent histories for question answering. Its AgentRunbook variants contrast indexed knowledge pools with coding-agent retrieval from stored trajectory files.
authors: Di Wu; Zixiang Ji; Asmi Kawatkar; Bryan Kwan; Jia-Chen Gu; Nanyun Peng; Kai-Wei Chang

name: Covering Human Action Space for Computer Use: Data Synthesis and Benchmark
summary: Introduces CUActSpot to evaluate clicks, drags, drawing and other screen interactions across GUI, text, tables, canvases and natural images. A renderer-based pipeline records geometry and screenshots, then generates matching instructions and action traces for training a grounding model.
authors: Miaosen Zhang; Xiaohan Zhao; Zhihong Tan; Zhou Huoshen; Yijia Fan; Yifan Yang; Kai Qiu; Bei Liu; Justin Wagle; Chenzhong Yin; Mingxi Cheng; Ji Li; Qi Dai; Chong Luo; Xu Yang; Xin Geng; Baining Guo

name: What Happens Before Decoding? Prefill Determines GUI Grounding in VLMs
summary: Re-Prefill adds an attention-guided second prefill pass that revisits candidate screen regions before coordinate generation. The study evaluates this training-free intervention across GUI-grounding models and benchmarks.
authors: Jiaping Lin; Fei Shen; Junzhe Li; Ping Nie; Fei Yu; Ming Li; Haizhou Li

name: SimPersona: Learning Discrete Buyer Personas from Raw Clickstreams for Grounded E-Commerce Agents
summary: SimPersona learns buyer types from clickstreams and uses persona tokens to condition web agents trained on browsing traces for live storefront tasks.
authors: Zahra Zanjani Foumani; Alberto Castelo; Shuang Xie; Ted Chaiwachirasak; Han Li; Lingyun Wang

name: Web Agents Should Adopt the Plan-Then-Execute Paradigm
summary: Argues for compiling web tasks into predefined execution graphs before exposing an agent to untrusted runtime content. Its WebArena task analysis identifies typed, semantically complete website tools as a prerequisite and distinguishes this interface proposal from reactive click-level control.
authors: Julien Piet; Annabella Chow; Yiwei Hou; Muxi Lyu; Sylvie Venuto; Jinhao Zhu; Raluca Ada Popa; David Wagner

name: Beyond Binary: Reframing GUI Critique as Continuous Semantic Alignment
summary: BBCritic ranks candidate GUI-agent actions through instruction–action alignment, while BBBench evaluates fine-grained ranking with a hierarchical action taxonomy.
authors: Yuchen Sun; Pei Fu; Shaojie Zhang; Anan Du; Xiuwen Xi; Ruoceng Zhang; Zhenbo Luo; Jian Luan; Chongyang Zhang

name: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
summary: Video2GUI extracts GUI interaction trajectories from tutorial videos to build WildGUI, a pretraining dataset spanning applications and websites.
authors: Weimin Xiong; Shuhao Gu; Bowen Ye; Zihao Yue; Lei Li; Feifan Song; Sujian Li; Hao Tian
venue: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning

name: Known By Their Actions: Fingerprinting LLM Browser Agents via UI Traces
summary: A study shows that websites can infer the model behind a browser agent from passively recorded UI actions and timing traces across web tasks.
authors: William Lugoloobi; Samuelle Marro; Jabez Magomere; Joss Wright; Chris Russell

name: WARD: Adversarially Robust Defense of Web Agents Against Prompt Injections
summary: WARD guards web agents against prompt injections in HTML and visual interfaces, using web data and adaptive attacker–guard training.
authors: Tri Cao; Yulin Chen; Hieu Cao; Yibo Li; Khoi Le; Thong Nguyen; Yuexin Li; Yufei He; Yue Liu; Shuicheng Yan; Bryan Hooi

name: Orchard: An Open-Source Agentic Modeling Framework
summary: Orchard provides an environment service and training recipes for several agent domains, including Orchard-GUI, a vision-language computer-use agent.
authors: Baolin Peng; Wenlin Yao; Qianhui Wu; Hao Cheng; Xiao Yu; Rui Yang; Tao Ge; Alessandro Sordoni; Xingdi Yuan; Yelong Shen; Pengcheng He; Tong Zhang; Zhou Yu; Jianfeng Gao

name: DRS-GUI: Dynamic Region Search for Training-Free GUI Grounding
summary: DRS-GUI searches screenshot regions through focus, shift and scatter operations selected by a tree-search planner. A region-quality reward guides this training-free perceptual search before final GUI grounding.
authors: Yichao Liu; Huawen Shen; Liu Yu; Shiyu Liu; Zeyu Chen; Yu Zhou

name: SaaS-Bench: Can Computer-Use Agents Leverage Real-World SaaS to Solve Professional Workflows?
summary: SaaS-Bench evaluates browser agents on professional workflows across self-hosted applications. Weighted checkpoints measure task completion and partial progress, with application-state checks and configured content judges documented in the official harness.
authors: Kean Shi; Zihang Li; Tianyi Ma; Zengji Tu; Jialong Wu; Xinbo Xu; Qingyao Yang; Ruoyu Wu; Weichu Xie; Ming Wu; Jason Zeng; Michael Heinrich; Elvis Zhang; Liang Chen; Kuan Li; Baobao Chang
topics: web-navigation; evaluation; long-horizon; workflow; cross-app; state-tracking

name: PersonaFingerprint: Measuring Persona Inference on Modern Websites with LLM-Driven Browsing
summary: PersonaFingerprint studies persona inference from encrypted web traffic, using a persona-constrained computer-use agent to browse real websites and collect traces.
authors: Chuxu Song; Hao Wang; Richard Martin

name: PAGER: Bridging the Semantic-Execution Gap in Point-Precise Geometric GUI Control
summary: Introduces PAGE Bench for point-precise geometric GUI construction and PAGER, an agent that plans around primitive dependencies and executes pixel-level actions.
authors: Jingxuan Wei; Xi Bai; Shan Liu; Caijun Jia; Zheng Sun; Xinglong Xu; Siyuan Li; Linzhuang Sun; Bihui Yu; Conghui He; Cheng Tan

name: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration
summary: ScreenSearch explores desktop GUI states by indexing and deduplicating UIA-tree screens, then using outcome ambiguity and frontier rewards to guide graph search.
authors: Michael Solodko; Justin Wagle

name: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents
summary: ShopGym builds sandbox e-commerce storefronts from live shops and generates catalog-grounded tasks for evaluating web shopping agents in resettable environments.
authors: Chinmay Savadikar; Mingyu Zhao; Yuanzheng Zhu; Han Li; Shuang Xie; Alberto Castelo; Tianfu Wu; Lingyun Wang

name: WinDeskGround: A Benchmark for Robust GUI Grounding in Complex Multi-Window Desktop Environments
summary: WinDeskGround synthesizes multi-window desktop layouts with controlled occlusion, density and semantic similarity to test GUI grounding robustness. Its instruction-target benchmark measures how localization changes when interfaces depart from simple single-layer scenes.
authors: Haoren Zhao; Tianyi Chen; Zhen Wang

name: Skim: Speculative Execution for Fast and Efficient Web Agents
summary: Introduces Skim, a speculative execution framework for web agents that learns site URL and answer patterns offline, then uses them to answer matching queries with a small model.
authors: Mike Wong; Kevin Hsieh; Suman Nath; Ravi Netravali

name: SE-GA: Memory-Augmented Self-Evolution for GUI Agents
summary: SE-GA retrieves hierarchical memories during inference and uses the collected experience in a separate policy-improvement pipeline. Its evaluation includes offline grounding/action tasks and online Android interaction, which measure different capabilities.
authors: Shilong Jin; Lanjun Wang; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: TriAxialKV: Toward Extreme Low-Precision KV-Cache Quantization for Agentic Inference Tasks
summary: TriAxialKV assigns KV-cache precision by token recency, modality, and role for agentic inference, with a computer-use agent on OSWorld among its evaluations.
authors: Hanzhang Shen; Haoran Wu; Yiren Zhao; Robert Mullins

name: TClone: Low-Latency Forking of Live GUI Environments for Computer-Use Agents
summary: TClone versions live GUI workspaces through snapshots, isolated forks, rollback and selective commit or merge. It separates fast branch creation from durable checkpoints using copy-on-write sharing, filesystem versioning and asynchronous checkpointing, with end-to-end agent-loop latency measurements.
authors: Yutong Huang; Vikranth Srivatsa; Alex Asch; Hansin Tushar Patwa; Yiying Zhang

name: DiagEval: Trajectory-Conditioned Diagnosis for Reliable Software Evaluation with GUI Agents
summary: DiagEval diagnoses failed GUI-agent evaluations of interactive software by reusing failed trajectories for targeted probes that distinguish execution errors from defects.
authors: Sirui Hong; Zhijie Liu; Tengfei Li; Wei Tao; Yifan Wu; Chenglin Wu

name: MUIAnno: An Expert-Annotated Dataset and Evaluation Benchmark for Mobile UI Understanding
summary: MUIAnno provides expert labels for elements in manually explored mobile-app screens, with a web annotation tool that emits structured JSON. It also supplies UI-element detection baselines for the dataset.
authors: Athar Parvez; Muhammad Jawad Mufti; Muqaddas Gull; Omar Hammad

name: DocOS: Towards Proactive Document-Guided Actions in GUI Agents
summary: DocOS benchmarks agents that search online documentation and translate procedural instructions into GUI actions in interactive web environments. It separates failures to retrieve useful procedures from failures to ground retrieved instructions into executable actions.
authors: Jingjing Liu; Ziye Huang; Zihao Cheng; Zeming Liu; Jiahong Wu; Yuhang Guo; Kehai Chen; Yunhong Wang; Haifeng Wang

name: MementoGUI: Learning Agentic Multimodal Memory Control for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
summary: MementoGUI learns a controller for selecting, compressing and retrieving textual and region-level visual memories while leaving the GUI-agent backbone fixed. It also converts computer-use traces into controller training data and evaluates semantic actions, progress and memory consistency on long-horizon tasks.
authors: Ziyun Zeng; Hang Hua; Bocheng Zou; Mu Cai; Rogerio Feris; Jiebo Luo

name: OmniGUI: Benchmarking GUI Agents in Omni-Modal Smartphone Environments
summary: OmniGUI evaluates step-level action prediction from interleaved smartphone screenshots, synchronous audio and video. Expert demonstrations carry multimodal-dependency annotations, and initial baselines use native multimodal models as agent proxies to study temporal and audio-related failures.
authors: Felix Henry; Lihan Lin; Jiangyou Zhu; Yangfan; Bingqian Zhang; Min Chen; Shiyu Huang

name: AQuaUI: Visual Token Reduction for GUI Agents with Adaptive Quadtrees
summary: AQuaUI reduces screenshot tokens for GUI agents at inference time with adaptive quadtrees that retain spatial positions and reuse prior tree structure across steps.
authors: Yuankai Li; Tinghui Zhu; Ha Min Son; Zhe Zhao; Xin Liu; Muhao Chen

name: What and When to Distill: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
summary: SERL trains multi-turn agents by using task rewards and selective step feedback to weight updates, with WebShop among its evaluation settings.
authors: Xiaozhe Li; Tianyi Lyu; Yang Li; Yichuan Ma; Peiji Li; Linyang Li; Qipeng Guo; Dahua Lin; Kai Chen

name: CutVerse: A Compositional GUI Agents Benchmark for Media Post-Production Editing
summary: Cutverse benchmarks GUI agents on long editing workflows across professional media applications and parses recordings and input logs into grounded action trajectories.
authors: Haobo Hu; Xiangwu Guo; Zhiheng Chen; Difei Gao; Haotian Liu; Libiao Jin; Qi Mao

name: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Introduces OpenComputer, which builds desktop tasks around application-state verifiers and refines those verifiers using execution feedback. An evaluation harness records trajectories and assigns auditable partial credit across professional software workflows.
authors: Jinbiao Wei; Qianran Ma; Yilun Zhao; Xiao Zhou; Kangqi Ni; Guo Gan; Arman Cohan

name: Weasel: Out-of-Domain Generalization for Web Agents via Importance-Diversity Data Selection
summary: Weasel selects web-agent training steps by balancing importance and diversity across states, sites and interaction patterns. It also prunes training accessibility trees around known action targets and regenerates rationales to match the model’s reasoning style.
authors: Fatemeh Pesaran Zadeh; Seyeon Choi; Xing Han Lù; Siva Reddy; Gunhee Kim

name: MemGym: a Long-Horizon Memory Environment for LLM Agents
summary: MemGym benchmarks agent memory across several task regimes, including computer use on WebArena-Infinity, with scores designed to isolate memory performance.
authors: Wujiang Xu; Yu Wang; Kai Mei; Kaiqu Liang; Zhenting Wang; Mingyu Jin; Han Zhang; Shi-Xiong Zhang; Wenyue Hua; Sambit Sahu; Dimitris N. Metaxas

name: Agent JIT Compilation for Latency-Optimizing Web Agent Planning and Scheduling
summary: Agent JIT compilation turns browser task descriptions into validated executable plans containing model calls, tools and parallel work. A cost-based scheduler and pre/postcondition protocol target latency and incorrect tool use in web-agent execution.
authors: Caleb Winston; Ron Yifeng Wang; Azalia Mirhoseini; Christos Kozyrakis

name: Spreadsheet-RL: Advancing Large Language Model Agents on Realistic Spreadsheet Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Spreadsheet-RL trains spreadsheet agents with RL in a Microsoft Excel environment exposed through a Python sandbox and supplies the Domain-Spreadsheet benchmark.
authors: Banghao Chi; Yining Xie; Mingyuan Wu; Jingcheng Yang; Jize Jiang; Zhaoheng Li; Shengyi Qian; Minjia Zhang; Klara Nahrstedt; Rui Hou; Xiangjun Fan; Hanchao Yu

name: DRIVE: Modeling Skills at the Reasoning and Interaction Levels for Web Agents under Continual Learning
summary: DRIVE separates reusable reasoning skills from page-specific interaction skills for web agents, retrieving both to plan tasks and execute actions on websites.
authors: Xirui Liu; Sihang Zhou; Yanning Hou; Rong Zhou; Haoyuan Chen; Maolin He; Siwei Wang; Hao Chen; Jian Huang

name: PANDO: Efficient Multimodal AI Agents via Online Skill Distillation
summary: Analyzes inefficiency in VisualWebArena trajectories and distills reusable online skills to reduce repeated actions and token overhead in multimodal web agents.
authors: Yubo Li; Yidi Miao; Yuntian Shen; Yuxin Liu

name: ScaleWoB: Guiding GUI Agents with Coding Agents via Large-Scale Environmental Synthesis
summary: Introduces ScaleWoB, which synthesizes interactive GUI environments as backend-free webpages with verifiable rewards. Its mobile-oriented benchmark evaluates agent execution and compares selected synthetic tasks with real-app behavior.
authors: Guohong Liu; Jialei Ye; Pengzhi Gao; Wei Liu; Jian Luan; Yunxin Liu; Yuanchun Li

name: CUA-Gym: Scaling Verifiable Training Environments and Tasks for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Presents CUA-Gym, which co-generates instructions, initial and target states, and executable reward checks through generator-discriminator iterations. Mock web applications expand training environments, with learned agents evaluated on OSWorld-Verified and WebArena.
authors: Bowen Wang; Dunjie Lu; Junli Wang; Tianyi Bai; Shixuan Liu; Zhipeng Zhang; Haiquan Wang; Hao Hu; Tianbao Xie; Shuai Bai; Dayiheng Liu; Que Shen; Junyang Lin; Tao Yu

name: AgentHijack: Benchmarking Computer Use Agent Robustness to Common Environment Corruptions
summary: Introduces AgentHijack, a benchmark for desktop computer-use agents facing pop-ups, resolution changes and other common corruptions, alongside an agent that checks its environment.
authors: Jingwei Sun; Jianing Zhu; Yuanyi Li; Tongliang Liu; Xia HU; Bo Han

name: Claw-Anything: Benchmarking Always-On Personal Assistants with Broader Access to User's Digital World
summary: Claw-Anything benchmarks persistent personal assistance across activity histories, backend services and integrated GUI/CLI interaction. Its simulated event histories introduce irrelevant or conflicting context, and a separate generation pipeline supplies training environments.
authors: Yusong Lin; Xinyuan Liang; Haiyang Wang; Qipeng Gu; Siqi Cheng; Jiangui Chen; Shuzhe Wu; Feiyang Pan; Lue Fan; Sanyuan Zhao; Dandan Tu
topics: evaluation; interaction-history; long-horizon; robustness; data-generation; workflow

name: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
summary: Introduces MobileGym, a browser-hosted simulation of mobile app interactions whose configurable JSON state supports deterministic judging and parallel rollouts. MobileGym-Bench adds parameterized tasks, with experiments examining online training and transfer to real devices.
authors: Dingbang Wu; Rui Hao; Haiyang Wang; Shuzhe Wu; Han Xiao; Zhenghong Li; Bojiang Zhou; Zheng Ju; Zichen Liu; Lue Fan; Zhaoxiang Zhang

name: VISTA: An End-to-End Benchmark for Visual Spec-to-Web-App Coding Agents
summary: VISTA evaluates coding agents that turn design handoffs into working web and Android applications. Its evaluator locates annotated interactive components and probes their behavior, keeping visual localization distinct from functional correctness.
authors: JunJia Guo; Yuhang Yao; Chang Li; Zimeng Pan; Jiawei; Zhou; Jingdi Chen

name: Anchor: Preventing Artifact Drift for Reliable Agent Verification
summary: Anchor builds ERP-Bench by generating procurement and manufacturing tasks with shared state verifiers for evaluating browser and computer-use agents.
authors: Abhijay Rana; Maksim Ivanov

name: MobileExplorer: Accelerating On-Device Inference for Mobile GUI Agents via Online Exploration
summary: MobileExplorer probes relevant UI elements while an on-device model is reasoning, then supplies the exploration trace as compact context. A two-level rollback mechanism restores the working state when simple backtracking fails.
authors: Runxi Huang; Liyu Zhang; Shengzhong Liu; Xiaomin Ouyang

name: ChartAct: A Benchmark for Dynamic Chart Understanding
summary: ChartAct benchmarks multimodal models and GUI agents on interactive charts from websites, requiring actions such as hovering or zooming to answer questions.
authors: Muye Huang; Lin Wu; Lingling Zhang; Hang Yan; Zhiyuan Wang; Yumeng Fu; Zesheng Yang; Jun Liu

name: Scaling, Benchmarking, and Reasoning of Vision-Language Agents for Mobile GUI Navigation
summary: HyperTrack provides mobile GUI navigation tasks across Chinese apps, while GUIEvalKit benchmarks VLM agents offline and supports analysis of training scale and history.
authors: Heng Qu; Yike Liu; Renren Jin; Wenzong Zhang; Pengzhi Gao; Wei Liu; Jian Luan

name: AndroidDaily: A Verifiable Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents on Real-World Closed-Source Applications
summary: AndroidDaily evaluates mobile GUI agents on daily workflows in closed-source Android apps. Its GRADE evaluator follows visual trajectories against operational obligations, output-quality requirements and negative constraints, producing process-level diagnostics without hidden app state.
authors: Yifan Sui; Xin Huang; Hongbing Li; Fang Xu; Jiahe Lv; Haolong Yan; Yeqing Shen; Litao Liu; Zhimin Fan; Ziyang Meng; Jia Wang; Junbo Qi; Kaijun Tan; Zheng Ge; Xiangyu Zhang; Daxin Jiang; Osamu Yoshie

name: MIRAGE: Context-Aware Prompt Injection against Mobile GUI Agents via User-Generated Content
summary: MIRAGE constructs mobile screenshot injections in ordinary user-content regions through localization, contextual payload generation and realism curation. Its evaluation separates visual realism from attack effectiveness against pixel-observing GUI agents.
authors: Ruoqi Guo; Yi Liu; Gelei Deng; Yiheng Xiong; Yuekang Li; Ying Zhang; Leo Yu Zhang; Lida Zhao; Ji Jie; Yuxiao Lu

name: GUI Agents for Continual Game Generation
summary: PlaytestArena evaluates generated browser games using expected in-play behaviors adjudicated by GUI agents. Play2Code pairs a coding agent with a rubric-blind GUI playtester whose interaction traces and feedback guide iterative refinement, with a separate final judge.
authors: Yixu Huang; Bo Li; Na Li; Zhe Wang; Kaijie Chen; Haonan Ge; Qingyi Si; Yuanzhe Shen; Ruihan Yang; Guangjing Wang; Hongcheng Guo

name: GUI-CIDER: Mid-training GUI Agents via Causal Internalization and Density-aware Exemplar Reselection
summary: GUI-CIDER turns GUI trajectories into textual planning and causal interface knowledge, reselects exemplars for causal structure and low redundancy, then mid-trains GUI agents on that corpus.
authors: Zheng Wu; Chengcheng Han; Zhengxi Lu; Tianjie Ju; Yanyu Chen; Qi Gu; Xunliang Cai; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: Mobile-Aptus: Confidence-Driven Proactive and Robust Interaction in MLLM-based Mobile-Using Agents
summary: Mobile-Aptus trains mobile agents to output actions and confidence scores, then corrects confidence bias to guide when they request human help.
authors: Zheng Wu; Pengzhou Cheng; Zongru Wu; Yuan Guo; Tianjie Ju; Aston Zhang; Gongshen Liu; Zhuosheng Zhang

name: MaskClaw: Edge-Side Personalized Privacy Arbitration for GUI Agents with Behavior-Driven Skill Evolution
summary: MaskClaw makes local Allow, Mask or Ask decisions before GUI screenshots leave a trusted environment, using visual evidence and personalized policy memory. Its benchmark and designed evolution scenarios test how corrections and edits can become privacy skills checked by a sandbox gate.
authors: Yanqiu Zhao; Dongying Zheng; Kaibo Huang; Yukun Wei; Zhongliang Yang; Linna Zhou

name: Learn from Weaknesses: Automated Domain Specialization for Small Computer-Use Agents
summary: LearnWeak specializes small computer-use agents by finding domain-specific weaknesses, generating targeted tasks, and training separately for planning and execution errors.
authors: Suji Kim; Kangsan Kim; Sung Ju Hwang

name: PRO-CUA: Process-Reward Optimization for Computer Use Agents
summary: PRO-CUA trains computer-use agents with step-level RL, scoring candidate actions from live rollouts with a process reward model and evaluating on live web benchmarks.
authors: Yifei He; Rui Yang; Hao Bai; Tong Zhang; Han Zhao

name: GTA: Generating Long-Horizon Tasks for Web Agents at Scale
summary: GTA generates multi-hop web-agent tasks and executable trajectories through crawling, retrieval, and validation, releasing a benchmark built from over 50 websites.
authors: Tenghao Huang; Kung-Hsiang Huang; Prafulla Kumar Choubey; Yilun Zhou; Muhao Chen; Jonathan May; Chien-Sheng Wu

name: STAMP: Training Explicit Memory for Mobile GUI Agents in Controllable and Scalable Virtual Environments
summary: STAMP trains explicit memory for mobile GUI agents in virtual environments by injecting facts into generated tasks and using supervised data and online RL.
authors: Junyang Wang; Haiyang Xu; Xi Zhang; Zhaoqing Zhu; Ming Yan; Jieping Ye; Jitao Sang

name: Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents: Comprehensive Evaluation with a Lightweight Framework
summary: Introduces a lightweight framework for evaluating HTML reduction in web agents, using Minimal Failure Set coverage to assess pruning and optimize latency.
authors: Masafumi Enomoto; Ryoma Obara; Haochen Zhang; Masafumi Oyamada

name: Recovering Policy-Induced Errors: Benchmarking and Trajectory Synthesis for Robust GUI Agents
summary: GUI-RobustEval measures how GUI agents recover from their own errors, while RoTS synthesizes recovery trajectories for training on varied failure modes.
authors: Tianpeng Bu; Xin Liu; Qihua Chen; Hao Jiang; Shurui Li; Hongtao Duan; Lu Jiang; Lulu Hu; Bin Yang; Minying Zhang

name: PhoneWorld: From Real-App Trajectories to Dynamic and Verifiable Environments for Phone-Use Agents
summary: Introduces PhoneWorld, which converts observed app pages, transitions and state changes into executable Android environments through a build-inspect-repair process. Generated tasks and programmatic verifiers support benchmarking, trajectory collection and online training.
authors: Yuxuan Liu; Xin Lai; Junyi Li; Pengyuan Lyu; Jason; Yiduo Guo; Zhengyao Fang; Yang Ding; Yi Zhang; Weinong Wang; Huawen Shen; Xingran Zhou; Liang Wu; Fei Tang; Sunqi Fan; Shangpin Peng; Zheng Ruan; Anran Zhang; Chengquan Zhang; Han Hu; Benyou Wang; Ji-Rong Wen; Rui Yan; Zhengyang Tang

name: UI-KOBE: Knowledge-Oriented Behavior Exploration for Lightweight Graph-Guided GUI Agents
summary: UI-KOBE explores mobile applications to build graphs of UI states and executable transitions. A lightweight agent then matches its current screenshot to the graph and chooses a transition, local action, completion signal or fallback action.
authors: Yuxiang Chai; Han Xiao; Xinyu Fu; Jinpeng Chen; Rui Liu; Hongsheng Li

name: DiffSpot: Can VLMs Spot Fine-Grained Visual Differences in Web Interfaces?
summary: DiffSpot benchmarks detection of fine visual changes in rendered web interfaces using image pairs created by single-property CSS mutations.
authors: Linhao Zhang; Aiwei Liu; Yuan Liu; Xiao Zhou

name: GUI-C$^2$: Coarse-to-Fine GUI Grounding via Difficulty-Aware Reinforcement Learning
summary: Introduces GUI-D to score training samples by difficulty and GUI-C² to refine screen-element locations through area-gated cropping and reinforcement learning.
authors: Junlong Li; Chao Hao; Lap-Pui Chau; Yi Wang

name: BlueFin: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Financial Spreadsheets
summary: Introduces BlueFin, a benchmark and evaluation framework for agents handling professional finance spreadsheet workbooks through synthesis, manipulation, and comprehension tasks.
authors: Srivatsa Kundurthy; Clara Na; Colton Moraine; Anoushka Mohta; Case Winter; George Fang; John Ling; Emma Strubell; Zach Kirshner

name: Learning to Adapt: Self-Improving Web Agent via Cognitive-Aware Exploration
summary: Introduces SCALE, which uses exploration roles and graph planning to train web agents, and SCALE-20k, a dataset of tasks and demonstrations from real websites.
authors: Weile Chen; Bingchen Miao; Qifan Yu; Wendong Bu; Guoming Wang; Wenqiao Zhang; Shengyu Zhang; Juncheng Li; Siliang Tang

name: Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents -- Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism
summary: Studies when masking older retrieved pages helps long-horizon search agents manage context, using offline and live-web search benchmarks and analysis of reopened pages.
authors: Haoxiang Zhang; Qixin Xu; Zhuofeng Li; Lei Zhang; Pengcheng Jiang; Yu Zhang; Julian McAuley

name: BraveGuard: From Open-World Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
summary: Introduces BraveGuard, a framework that turns emerging threats and computer-use agent trajectories into training supervision for guards that monitor multi-step safety risks.
authors: Yunhao Feng; Xiaohu Du; Xinhao Deng; Yifan Ding; Ming Wen; Yixu Wang; Yuxiang Xie; Baihui Zheng; Yingshui Tan; Yige Li; Yutao Wu; Kerui Cao; Wenke Huang; Yanming Guo; Xingjun Ma; Yu-Gang Jiang

name: Multi-Agent Computer Use
summary: MACU represents computer-use objectives as a dependency graph whose manager dispatches parallel subagents and revises tasks as new information arrives. Desktop and web experiments examine coordination, information handoff and task-completion time.
authors: Jing Yu Koh; Ruslan Salakhutdinov; Daniel Fried

name: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
summary: STaR-KV compresses GUI-agent KV caches by calibrating visual-token importance across attention subspaces and interaction time. Its training-free scoring combines spatial specialization, temporal redundancy and an adaptive temperature, evaluated at matched cache budgets.
authors: Yuhang Han; Wenzheng Yang; Yujie Chen; Xiangqi Jin; Yaojie Zhang; Siteng Huang; Linfeng Zhang

name: OpenWebRL: Demystifying Online Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning for Visual Web Agents
summary: Introduces OpenWebRL, a framework for training visual web agents with online multi-turn reinforcement learning on live websites, including browser infrastructure and success judging.
authors: Rui Yang; Qianhui Wu; Yuxi Chen; Hao Bai; Wenlin Yao; Hao Cheng; Baolin Peng; Huan Zhang; Tong Zhang; Jianfeng Gao

name: Context-Aware Workflow Decomposition for Automated Mobile UI Annotation Using Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Studies staged prompting for automated mobile UI element annotation, comparing workflow depths and element groupings on expert-annotated MUIAnno screens.
authors: Athar Parvez; Muhammad Jawad Mufti; Muqaddas Gull; Omar Hammad

name: DeskCraft: Benchmarking Desktop Agents on Professional Workflows and Human-in-the-Loop Collaboration
summary: DeskCraft evaluates professional desktop workflows and human-agent collaboration through mid-execution clarification, interruption and post-completion feedback. Its tasks cover creative applications and expose difficulties in long-horizon execution and proactive clarification.
authors: Wenkai Wang; Tao Xiong; Jingchen Ni; Yunpeng Bao; Xiyun Li; Tianqi Liu; Hongcan Guo; Zilong Huang; Shengyu Zhang

name: MedCUA-Bench: A Screenshot-Only Benchmark for Clinical Computer-Use Agents
summary: MedCUA-Bench evaluates screenshot-only clinical interface workflows using paired intent- and step-level goals. It combines reconstructed medical interfaces with completion and clinical-safety checks, and separately reports results on a real OpenEMR system.
authors: Jia Yu; Zilong Wang; Xinyang Jiang; Dongsheng Li; Shuo Wang

name: Perceive Before Reasoning: A Pre-Reasoning Perception Framework for Efficient and Reliable Proactive Mobile Agents
summary: Introduces PRPF, a two-stage framework for proactive mobile agents that gates intervention with MPP and invokes PAR only when assistance is warranted.
authors: Zhijie Ding; Weinan Hong; Zicheng Zhu; Lei Li; Dezhi Kong; Hao Wang; Peng Zhou; Xuchu Jiang; Jiaming Xu

name: CLI-Anything: Towards Agent-Native Computer Use
summary: CLI-Anything argues for application interfaces built around structured commands, explicit state and execution feedback. It describes transforming existing software into command-line harnesses and organizing that approach through CLI-Hub.
authors: Yuhao Yang; Tianyu Fan; Chao Huang

name: Demo2Tutorial: From Human Experience to Multimodal Software Tutorials
summary: Introduces Demo2Tutorial, which turns recorded software interactions into multimodal tutorials with task graphs and reports benefits for GUI-agent planning.
authors: Zechen Bai; Zhiheng Chen; Yiqi Lin; Kevin Qinghong Lin; Difei Gao; Xiangwu Guo; Xin Wang; Mike Zheng Shou

name: Online Skill Learning for Web Agents via State-Grounded Dynamic Retrieval
summary: State-Grounded Dynamic Retrieval extracts reusable sub-procedures from completed web trajectories and represents them as paired text and code. Skills are retrieved against both the current webpage state and the task goal at intermediate execution steps.
authors: Jiaxi Li; Ke Deng; Yun Wang; Jingyuan Huang; Yucheng Shi; Qiaoyu Tan; Jin Lu; Ninghao Liu

name: MIRAGE: Mobile Agents with Implicit Reasoning and Generative World Models
summary: Introduces MIRAGE, which trains mobile app agents to reason in compact latent states and anticipate future screenshots, reducing generated tokens during action selection.
authors: Zhichao Yang; Yuanze Hu; Haojie Hao; Longkun Hao; Dongshuo Huang; Hongyu Lin; Gen Li; Lanqing Hong; Yihang Lou; Yan Bai

name: Benchmarking Living-Screen-Native GUI Agents on Short-Video Platforms
summary: LivingScreen evaluates agents in a browser-based short-video environment where observing content consumes time and affects subsequent actions. Its task suite scores accuracy together with information efficiency to diagnose over- and under-observation on continuously changing screens.
authors: Jiashu Yao; Heyan Huang; Daiqing Wu; Wangke Chen; Huaxi Ai; Haoyu Wen; Zeming Liu; Yuhang Guo

name: AppAgent-Claw: CLI Is All You Need for GUI Automation
summary: Introduces AppAgent-Claw, which records demonstrated GUI workflows as reusable OpenClaw skills, locates visual targets during replay and checks intended on-screen effects.
authors: Zhixue Song; Zhiheng Zhang; Yi Song; Chi Zhang

name: Domain-Conditioned Safety in Frontier Computer-Using Agents: A 793-Episode Browser Benchmark, a Coding-Domain Cross-Reference, and a Reproducibility Audit of Recent Red-Teaming
summary: Introduces CUA-HandCrafted, a browser-agent red-teaming benchmark that varies attack templates, tasks and system prompts. Its domain comparison and reproducibility audit caution against transferring browser-surface safety conclusions to coding agents or unreleased optimized injections.
authors: Nicholas Saban

name: AsyncWebRL: Efficient Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Step Visual Web Agents
summary: AsyncWebRL overlaps web-agent rollouts, updates and policy refresh while managing screenshot handling and a persistent rollout pool. It also replaces trajectory-length normalization in multi-step GRPO to reduce verbose failed trajectories, with throughput and out-of-distribution evaluation.
authors: Hao Bai; Rui Yang; Chenlu Ye; Spencer Whitehead; Aviral Kumar; Tong Zhang

name: PerceptUI: LLM Agents as Human-Aligned Synthetic Users for UI/UX Evaluation
summary: Introduces PerceptUI, a persona-conditioned model for predicting how particular users answer questions about interfaces, supporting synthetic UI/UX evaluation.
authors: Nicolas Bougie; Xiaotong Ye; Gian Maria Marconi; Narimasa Watanabe

name: DragOn: A Benchmark and Dataset for Drag-Based GUI Interactions
summary: DragOn supplies drag-grounding training data and a held-out benchmark for highlighting text, selecting cells, resizing elements and moving sliders. It evaluates existing vision-language models and a model fine-tuned on the drag tasks.
authors: Nathan Bout; Maxime Langevin; Ronan Riochet

name: MacArena: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on an Online macOS Environment
summary: MacArena runs computer-use tasks through Apple’s virtualization framework on Apple Silicon, combining task ports with macOS-native workloads. It distinguishes the ported and native subsets when examining agent performance and cross-platform transfer.
authors: Victor Muryn; Maksym Shamrai; Sofiia Mazepa; Yehor Khodysko

name: Signal-Driven Observation for Long-Horizon Web Agents
summary: Proposes Signal-Driven Observation: a separate call selects relevant DOM elements and selectors, and a detector requests new observations only after meaningful browser events or failures. The paper frames observation timing and compression as an architectural research problem for long-horizon web agents.
authors: Shubham Gaur; Ian Lane

name: StainFlow: Entity-Stain Tracking and Evidence Linking for Process Rewards in GUI Agents
summary: StainFlow tracks visually verifiable task entities through GUI trajectories to identify phases and retrieve focused evidence windows. Its process-reward model is tested for both online policy learning and trajectory-completion judgments.
authors: Haojie Hao; Longkun Hao; Yihang Lou; Yan Bai; Zhenyang Li; Zhichao Yang; Dongshuo Huang; Hongyu Lin; Lanqing Hong; Jiakai Wang; Xianglong Liu

name: Self-evolving LLM agents with in-distribution Optimization
summary: Introduces Q-Evolve, which derives step-wise rewards from an in-distribution critic for LLM agent learning; WebShop is one of its interactive evaluation settings.
authors: Yudi Zhang; Meng Fang; Zhenfang Chen; Mykola Pechenizkiy

name: Syll: Open-Source Personal Automation with Cross-Surface Execution
summary: Syll combines tool calls, shell execution and visual GUI control in a personal-automation runtime. It turns user demonstrations into reusable skills and exposes execution logs, keyframes and approval checkpoints for inspection.
authors: Bo Zhang; Borui Zhang; Chenghao Jiang; Minglei Shi; Xiaofeng Wang; Zheng Zhu; Jie Zhou; Jiwen Lu
topics: automation; human-in-the-loop; workflow; memory; recording; observability

name: RunAgent SuperBrowser: A Theory of Autonomous Web Navigation Grounded in Human Browsing Behaviour
summary: SUPERBROWSER combines screenshot-based target proposals with separate orchestration, planning and action roles. A bounded ledger and context-eviction process retain recent actions, task facts and checkpoints during browser execution.
authors: Radeen Mostafa; Sawradip Saha

name: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
summary: WeaveBench requires agents to combine GUI, command-line and code operations within long tasks on an Ubuntu desktop. A trajectory-aware judge checks deliverables and interaction evidence, including shortcut behavior that outcome-only grading can miss.
authors: Wanli Li; Bowen Zhou; Yunyao Yu; Zhou Xu; Yifan Yang; Dongsheng Li; Caihua Shan

name: AliyunConsoleAgent: Training Web Agents in Real-World Cloud Environments via Distillation and Reinforcement Learning
summary: AliyunConsoleAgent trains browser agents to verify documented procedures against changing cloud-console UIs through trajectory distillation and online GRPO. Provisioned rollout environments and backend audit-log checks support training and outcome evaluation.
authors: Bojie Rong; Zheyu Shen; Qiaoping Wang; Pengfei Kang; Yang Xu; Yawen Wei; Hanyu Wu; Zhi Zhao; Leihao Pei; Linquan Jiang

name: iOSWorld: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Phone Agents
summary: Introduces a native iOS simulator benchmark with persistent user data, multi-app tasks, and personalization-dependent phone workflows.
authors: Lawrence Keunho Jang; Mareks Woodside; Geronimo Carom; Andrew Keunwoo Jang; Jing Yu Koh; Ruslan Salakhutdinov

name: WebChallenger: A Reliable and Efficient Generalist Web Agent
summary: WebChallenger builds a hierarchical DOM-derived page representation for selective observation, reusable site maps and compound actions. The framework combines these mechanisms without model fine-tuning and evaluates generalization across multiple web-agent benchmarks.
authors: Jayoo Hwang; Xiaowen Zhang; Vedant Padwal

name: GUI-AC: Enhancing Continual Learning in GUI Agents
summary: GUI-AC uses grounding certainty to adjust advantage weighting and policy-clipping bounds during continual reinforcement fine-tuning. Its mechanisms aim to suppress noisy confidence updates while retaining exploration under shifting GUI domains and resolutions.
authors: Can Lin; Tao Feng; Hangjie Yuan; Dan Zhang; Yifan Zhu; Zhonghong Ou

name: MemVenom: Triggered Poisoning of Multimodal Memories in Web Agents
summary: Introduces MemVenom, a black-box attack that plants coordinated text and image content in web-agent memory to trigger retrieval and redirect later actions.
authors: Yv Zhang; Hao Sun; Hao Fang; Kuofeng Gao; Fan Mo; Bin Chen; Shu-Tao Xia; Yaowei Wang

name: Workflow-GYM: Towards Long-Horizon Evaluation of Computer-use Agentic tasks in Real-World Professional Fields
summary: Workflow-GYM evaluates long GUI workflows in professional software. Its analysis examines failures such as omitted stages, accumulated errors and goal drift during specialized end-to-end work.

name: A History-Aware Visually Grounded Critic for Computer Use Agents
